title: The Ionospheric Cut-off as a Potential Radio Technosignature
background_knowledge: 无线电技术特征（radio technosignature）是 SETI 的重要观测方向，其基本设想是：若系外行星存在技术文明，其表面或近表面可能产生宽带、非自然的无线电连续辐射。此类辐射在逃逸行星前必须穿过大气电离层；电离层由恒星 XUV 辐射 photoionisation 形成，常用 Chapman 层描述电子密度随高度的分布。冷等离子体中电磁波存在等离子体频率 $\nu_p$（由电子数密度决定），低于该频率的无线电波会被反射，高于者才能传播到太空，因此行星电离层会对表面起源的射电谱形成低频谱截止。对系外行星而言，这一截止频率取决于恒星 XUV 通量、大气成分与尺度等，并可能随行星轨道相位变化；这既可能掩盖或修改技术信号，也可反过来用于探测系外行星电离层。
contribution: 论文使用 photoionised 大气的 Chapman 层模型研究宽带无线电技术特征（BRaTs）穿过行星电离层的过程。作者指出，等离子体频率仅弱依赖于恒星 XUV 辐照，近似按 $Q_{\infty}^{1/4}$ 标度，因此多数位于宜居带的类地行星的截止频率约为 5–40 MHz，极端环境下可升至约 100 MHz。**基本信号特征是：表面起源 BRaT 的连续谱应在特征频率以下被强烈抑制，且该特征在任意轨道相位和任意观测几何下都应存在。** 斜传播、磁场和碰撞吸收会把尖锐截止平滑为逃逸函数 $f_{\mathrm{esc}}(\nu,\varphi)$，其中 $\varphi$ 为轨道相位。由于昼夜电离模式锚定在亚恒星点而非随行星表面自转，圆面积分产生第二个更具判别力的特征：**半逃逸频率 $\nu_{1/2}$ 会随轨道做可预测的约 40–50% 调制，并锁定于轨道历元**，具体幅度取决于泄漏辐射的角分布。有限大气响应时间会引入不大的相位滞后，但保留调制。作者强调，单凭低频转折并不唯一指向技术，但若转折随轨道周期规律变化，则已知天体物理过程难以复制；该电离层截止虽观测困难，却可作为潜在技术特征诊断和探测系外行星电离层的新手段。
summary: Radio emission generated on a planetary surface must cross the planet's ionosphere before escaping into space: below the local plasma frequency it is reflected back towards the surface. We investigate this process for broadband radio technosignatures (BRaTs) using a Chapman-layer description of photoionised atmospheres. The plasma frequency depends only weakly on stellar XUV irradiation, scaling as $Q_{\infty}^{1/4}$, implying turnover frequencies of 5-40 MHz for most terrestrial habitable-zone planets, potentially rising towards 100 MHz in extreme environments. The basic signature is simple: the continuum of a surface-origin BRaT should be strongly suppressed below a characteristic frequency that can be estimated from the XUV output of the host star, at every orbital phase and for any viewing geometry. Oblique propagation, magnetic fields, and collisional absorption broaden the cut-off into a smooth escape function, $f_{\mathrm{esc}}(ν,φ)$, where $φ$ is the orbital phase. Because the day-night ionisation pattern is anchored to the substellar point rather than to the rotating surface, disc integration adds a second, more discriminating signature: the half-escape frequency $ν_{1/2}$ varies predictably (by about 40-50 per cent over the orbit, depending on the angular emission pattern of the leakage) and remains locked to the orbital ephemeris. Finite atmospheric response times introduce modest phase lags but preserve the modulation. A low-frequency turnover alone is not unique to technology, but one that varies periodically with the orbital period would be difficult to reproduce through known astrophysical processes. Although observationally challenging, the ionospheric cut-off is a potential technosignature diagnostic and a novel probe of exoplanet ionospheres.

title: Magnolia: a highly magnetized galaxy at redshift $z\simeq9$
background_knowledge: 星系磁场是星际介质的重要组成部分。在本地宇宙中，银河系等星系普遍具有几 $\mu\mathrm{G}$ 量级、在千秒差距尺度上部分相干的磁场，其能量密度可与湍流和宇宙线能量密度相比，并通过磁压、宇宙线输运、气体冷却与恒星形成反馈等过程影响星系演化。其基本物理图像是：弱种子磁场由天体物理电池效应或注入过程产生，随后在湍流、差动旋转和超新星驱动等作用下，经由小尺度湍流发电机与大尺度发电机被放大和有序化。经典发电机理论需要足够多的转动周期和湍流涡旋周期，因此通常预期高红移早期星系的星际介质在大尺度上仍接近未磁化。观测上，尘埃偏振、塞曼效应和同步辐射等可用于探测磁场；近年高红移尘埃偏振信号对上述图像提出了挑战。数值研究方面，宇宙学变焦模拟结合辐射-磁流体动力学（RMHD）与非平衡化学，可在星系形成背景下追踪磁场从种子到星系尺度的放大，并用磁场与动能功率谱、谱能量转移函数以及等离子体 $\beta$ 参数 $\beta = P_{\mathrm{gas}}/P_{\mathrm{mag}}$ 等诊断放大机制。
contribution: 本文是 MAGNA SERRA 模拟套件的首篇工作。该套件由带非平衡化学的宇宙学辐射-磁流体动力学（RMHD）变焦模拟组成，旨在研究早期星系磁场的完整增长物理。作者用 RAMSES-RT 在质量分辨率约 $10^4\ \mathrm{M}_\odot$、空间分辨率约 $10\ \mathrm{pc}$ 下模拟了位于约 $10^{11}\ \mathrm{M}_\odot$ 暗物质晕中的星系 Magnolia。到 $z \simeq 9$ 时，Magnolia 的恒星质量约为 $10^8\ \mathrm{M}_\odot$ 的数倍，并已高度磁化：在最致密区域磁场达到几 $\mu\mathrm{G}$，等离子体 $\beta$ 参数 $\beta \simeq 0.1$，表明磁压主导。**这种强放大在约 40 Myr 内完成**，源于星系高度动态的结构所造成的大尺度压缩与剪切。磁场与动能功率谱及谱能量转移函数并不支持发电机作用，而更倾向于：**磁场先由大尺度压缩放大，随后由小尺度向大尺度重组**。因此，**在极高红移处强星系磁化是可能的，磁场可在星系整个演化历史中扮演主导角色**。
summary: The theory of galactic magnetic field growth via dynamo action predicts that the interstellar medium (ISM) of early galaxies would remain virtually unmagnetized on large scales. However, recent observations of strong dust polarization in galaxies at redshifts $z\simeq2.6$ and $z\simeq5.6$ challenge this paradigm. If galaxies indeed host strong, large-scale, coherent magnetic fields at high-$z$, then galaxy evolution and current theories of magnetic field amplification in galaxies should be revisited. To address the full physical complexity of early magnetic field growth in galaxies, we have designed MAGNA SERRA, a suite of radiation-magneto-hydrodynamical (RMHD) cosmological zoom-in simulations with non-equilibrium chemistry. In this first paper from the MAGNA SERRA suite, we present Magnolia, a galaxy hosted in a $\simeq 10^{11}~\mathrm{M}_\odot$ dark matter halo simulated with RAMSES-RT with a $\simeq 10^4~\mathrm{M}_\odot$ mass ($\simeq 10 \,\mathrm{pc}$ spatial) resolution. We find that, at $z\simeq9$, Magnolia has a stellar mass of a few times $10^8~\mathrm{M}_\odot$ and is strongly magnetized, reaching a magnetic field of a few $μG$ and a plasma beta $β\simeq 0.1$ in the densest regions. This strong amplification occurs over a timescale of about 40~Myrs due to the highly dynamical nature of the galaxy, which creates strong compressions and shear. The power spectra of the magnetic and kinetic energies and the spectral energy transfer functions do not suggest dynamo action, but rather an initial magnetic field amplification through a large-scale compression, and a later re-organization of this field from small to large scales. Our findings show that strong galactic magnetization is possible at very high redshifts, which means that magnetic fields can play a dominant role throughout a galaxy's evolutionary history. (abridged)

title: Dark Matter Model Implications of a Candidate Sub-halo Near the Sun, and the Data Needed to Discriminate Among Them
background_knowledge: 暗物质与暗能量是现代宇宙学的两大支柱。大量动力学、引力透镜、宇宙微波背景和大尺度结构观测表明，宇宙中约四分之一能量密度由暗物质贡献；暗物质不发光，主要通过引力影响可见物质，也可能具有极弱的非引力相互作用。结构形成理论通常采用冷暗物质 CDM 模型：微小初始密度扰动在引力作用下增长，形成从星系到星系团的暗物质晕，并在大尺度结构中产生子晕和相空间子结构。暗物质粒子的质量、速度分布、自相互作用、与重子的散射、衰变或湮灭性质，以及原初黑洞等替代形式，会改变小尺度结构、晕内密度分布、子晕存活率和辐射信号。脉冲星计时可测量沿视线方向随时间变化的加速度，因而对太阳附近的局域质量集中和暗物质子晕敏感；这类近邻探针与宇宙学观测、引力透镜、直接探测和间接探测互补。
contribution: 论文以脉冲星计时加速度所指示的太阳附近局域质量集中为对象，该质量集中与暗物质子晕一致；作者系统推导这类天体对暗物质本质的含义，并按可观测效应组织讨论：结构形成的抑制或增强、形成后的内部结构与存活、以及暗物质组分的辐射或散射。涉及的模型包括超轻波动暗物质、热与非热温暗物质、暗声学振荡与暗物质—重子散射、弹性和非弹性自相互作用、带反冲的不可见衰变、原初黑洞、间接探测，以及与 LUX-ZEPLIN 高能反冲候选事件的潜在联系。**核心结论是，这类近邻子晕可作为检验暗物质本质的天然实验室，但仅凭现有外部加速度测量无法确定其暗物质模型。** 现有加速度来自潮汐半径之外，对内部质量分布、子晕速度和子晕族群均不敏感。论文提出四条破除简并的观测路线：在晕内测量加速度，以区分点质量、尖峰 cuspy 和核心 cored 轮廓；利用引力透镜与吸积检验质量是否致密；利用湮灭或衰变辐射的形态探测内部轮廓；搜索共动恒星族以检验天体是否“暗”并测量其速度。**因此，甄别该候选子晕的暗物质性质需要潮汐半径内的加速度、透镜与吸积、辐射形态和共动恒星族等多探针数据。** 论文还将该计划与脉冲星计时阵列搜寻凌星暗物质子结构的工作对比：后者通过不同观测量探测质量极轻得多的天体。
summary: Pulsar-timing accelerations point to a localized mass concentration near the Sun, consistent with a dark matter sub-halo. We work out what such an object implies for the nature of dark matter, organizing the implications by their observable effect: suppression or enhancement of structure formation, internal structure and survival after formation, and emission or scattering by the constituents. We discuss ultralight wave dark matter, thermal and nonthermal warm dark matter, dark acoustic oscillations and dark matter-baryon scattering, elastic and inelastic self-interactions, invisible decays with recoil, primordial black holes, indirect detection, and a possible connection to the LUX-ZEPLIN high-energy recoil candidate. We then ask what new data would discriminate among these models. The existing accelerations are measured outside the tidal radius, where they are blind to the interior mass distribution, to the object's velocity, and to the sub-halo population. We identify four routes that lift these degeneracies: accelerations measured inside the halo, which separate point-mass, cuspy, and cored profiles; lensing and accretion, which test whether the mass is compact; the morphology of annihilation or decay emission, which probes the inner profile; and a search for a comoving stellar population, which tests whether the object is dark and measures its velocity. We also contrast this program with pulsar-timing-array searches for transiting dark matter substructure, which probe vastly lighter objects through a different observable.

title: A universal modal-noise limit for multimode photonic systems
background_knowledge:
该工作处在天文光子学（astrophotonics）、统计光学与精密光谱仪器的交叉领域。现代望远镜常先用多模光纤或光子灯笼收集并传输星光，再通过模式转换器把多个空间模式耦合到单模或少数模式，以匹配高分辨率光谱仪。多模系统中的各空间模式会相互干涉，形成随波长、温度、应力、弯曲和耦合条件变化的散斑（speckle）；当系统从多模过渡到单模时，这种起伏表现为模态噪声（modal noise），直接限制光度测量与光谱测量的稳定性，也是高精度视向速度测量、系外行星大气表征等任务的重要误差源。
\n传统研究通常对光纤、光子灯笼或集成器件逐一建模与标定，用蒙特卡洛或实验测量给出各自的噪声水平；其统计描述与经典散斑理论、有效模式数、模式混合和谱相干有关。参与比（participation ratio）是描述本征值分布集中程度的有效维度，可视为参与噪声的有效模态数。核心问题是：能否找到一个与具体器件无关、只由线性传输算符的模态结构决定的统一上限，并进一步把波长维度的噪声相关性同光谱测速误差联系起来。
contribution: 论文在固定输入功率和各向同性模态激发的假设下证明，任意线性多模光子系统的相对功率涨落由一个数决定：矩阵 $K = T^{\dagger} W T$ 的本征值参与比 $M_{\mathrm{eff}}$。作者对空间滤波光纤、有损光子灯笼（lossy lanterns）和集成模式转换器进行蒙特卡洛模拟，验证该规律，并说明它在适当极限下回到经典散斑极限。**因此，模态噪声存在一个由 $M_{\mathrm{eff}}$ 参数化的普适标度律，而不必逐器件重新定义。** 进一步，将 $K$ 推广为波长相关的 $K(\lambda)$，可得到模态噪声的谱相关函数，并给出闭式的视向速度误差；**当谱相关宽度等于谱线宽度时，速度误差达到最大。**
summary: Modal noise limits the photometric and spectroscopic stability of every multimode-to-single-mode photonic system, yet it is quantified device by device. For isotropic modal excitation at fixed input power, the fractional power fluctuation of any linear multimode system is shown to be fixed by one number: the participation ratio M_eff of the eigenvalues of K = T†WT. Monte Carlo for spatially filtered fibres, lossy lanterns, and integrated mode converters confirms the law, which recovers the classical speckle limits. Extending K to K(λ) gives the spectral correlation of modal noise and a closed-form velocity error, maximal when the correlation width equals the line width.

title: A novel pathway to stellar-mass black hole growth: Re-accretion of gas from stellar wind bubbles
background_knowledge: 该方向研究分子云中的恒星形成、大质量恒星的星风与电离辐射反馈、超新星爆炸，以及这些过程对星际介质结构和致密天体遗留物的影响。标准恒星演化模型认为，大质量恒星最终黑洞的质量受前身星初始质量、金属丰度、星风质量损失和双星相互作用限制；金属丰度越低，星风越弱，恒星可能保留更多质量。大质量恒星可通过核心坍缩超新星或直接坍缩形成黑洞；前者常伴随强抛射，后者在弱星风条件下更可能保留质量。大质量恒星在分子云中会吹出热气泡并扫出致密壳层，热传导、辐射冷却、重力与湍流共同决定气泡和壳层的演化。若黑洞形成时仍处在富气体环境，它就可能从残留气体中吸积而增重。引力波天文台探测到的双黑洞并合为检验这类形成通道提供了关键质量样本，相关研究通常结合恒星演化、星际介质流体动力学与吸积物理，并用 1D 与 3D 模拟及参数扫描探索不同云密度、金属丰度与前身星质量下的结果。
contribution: 论文利用 1D 与 3D 流体模拟，研究新生恒星质量黑洞能否从祖先星先前吹出的星风气泡中再吸积气体而显著增重。模拟纳入热传导、辐射冷却、重力、电离辐射、星风与超新星爆炸，覆盖 500 多组 1D 参数（初始云密度、引力束缚能、前身星质量 $40-257\,M_\odot$、金属丰度 $0.66\,Z_\odot$ 与 $0.016\,Z_\odot$），并追踪黑洞形成后数百万年的气泡演化；对显示显著再吸积的场景还用高分辨率 3D 模拟进行验证。**低金属丰度前身星经直接坍缩形成的黑洞，可从晚期慢星风造成的大质量内壳层吸积最多 $6.9\,M_\odot$ 的气体，使最终黑洞质量达到 $93\,M_\odot$**。**涉及超新星爆炸或高金属丰度前身星的场景没有显著再吸积**：快星风或超新星抛射物会有效清除气泡内部的致密结构，留下热而低密度的介质。该机制可能有助于解释引力波事件中观测到的偏高黑洞质量。
summary: The formation of high-mass stellar black holes (BHs) observed in mergers by gravitational wave observatories remains difficult to explain using standard models of stellar evolution. We investigate whether newly formed stellar-mass BHs in dense molecular clouds can significantly increase their final mass by accreting gas from pre-existing, wind-blown interstellar bubbles produced by their progenitor stars. We performed 1D and 3D hydrodynamic simulations of interstellar bubbles driven by stellar feedback, incorporating thermal conduction, radiative cooling, gravity, ionizing radiation, stellar winds, and supernova (SN) explosions. We modeled the subsequent accretion onto the central BH for two formation scenarios: core-collapse SN and direct collapse. Our parameter space study encompasses over 500 1D simulations, varying initial cloud densities, gravitational binding energies, progenitor masses ($40-257\,M_\odot$), and metallicities ($0.66\,Z_\odot$ and $0.016\,Z_\odot$), and tracks the bubble evolution for millions of years post-BH formation. Scenarios exhibiting significant re-accretion were further validated using high-resolution 3D simulations. Our simulations show that BHs formed via direct collapse from low-metallicity progenitors can accrete up to $6.9\,M_\odot$ of gas from massive inner shells formed by late-stage slow winds, resulting in final BH masses of up to $93\,M_\odot$. Conversely, we find no significant re-accretion in scenarios involving an SN explosion or high-metallicity progenitors; in these cases, fast winds or SN ejecta efficiently evacuate dense structures from the bubble interior, leaving behind a hot, low-density medium. [abridged] This mechanism may help explain the unexpectedly high masses of BHs observed in gravitational wave events.

title: Revealing galaxy assembly bias with luminosity-weighted marked correlations
background_knowledge: 在 $\Lambda$CDM 框架下，宇宙结构通过引力不稳定性层级增长，星系形成于暗物质晕中。晕质量是决定星系占据数、亮度和成团性的首要量；传统光晕占据分布（HOD）或条件光度函数模型通常假设，在固定晕质量下星系的统计性质与晕的其他属性无关。于是，星系投影两点相关函数 $w_p(r_p)$ 主要编码晕质量—星系关系及晕的空间聚类。所谓星系组装偏置，是指固定晕质量时，晕的聚类强度仍可能依赖形成时间、浓度、自旋等次级晕属性；若星系亮度等标记与这些次级属性相关，则星系聚类会获得超出质量依赖的额外信息。未加权两点相关函数对这类“隐藏”依赖不敏感，而标记相关函数给每个星系乘上标记（如亮度），统计标记—环境的相关性，可在 $w_p$ 相同的样本中区分不同组装历史。对亮度标记，若固定质量下的光度残差与标准化次级属性 $s$ 的相关强度为 $\rho$，则领头阶的投影标记相关函数差异可写为 $\Delta\mathcal{M}_p(r_p)\propto \rho^2 \sigma_{\log L}^2 \xi_{ss}(r_p)$，其中 $\sigma_{\log L}$ 是固定晕质量下对数光度的散射，$\xi_{ss}$ 是次级属性的空间相关函数。该图像构成用标记聚类检验星系组装偏置和次级晕信息的基础。
contribution: 论文提出一个受控的零检验：构造两类星系样本，其中星系光度均遵循相同的平均光度—晕质量关系及散射，但光度残差要么（A）与次级晕属性无关，要么（B）与标准化次级属性 $s$ 相关；两类模型具有相同的晕占据、星系位置、光度函数和未加权投影两点相关函数 $w_p(r_p)$，因此差别完全编码在光度标记中。作者给出领头阶预言，投影标记相关函数之差按 $\rho^2 \sigma_{\log L}^2 \xi_{ss}(r_p)$ 标度。利用 $0.1<z<0.4$ 的 DESI-BGS 模拟星表检验该框架，在 $0.11<r_p/(h^{-1}\,\mathrm{Mpc})<1.04$ 范围内探测到注入依赖造成的标记聚类偏离，相对零假设协方差得到 $\chi^2=30.14$；单参数检验在 $|\rho|>0.63$ 时以超过 $5\sigma$ 显著性（$p=2.13\times10^{-7}$）拒绝仅质量假设。固定 $\sigma_{\log L}=0.23$ 时，弱至 $|\rho|\simeq0.52$ 的相关性仍可探测，且结果在 HOD 方案和建模的星系选择效应变化下保持稳定。**这些结果确立了亮度加权标记聚类作为一种灵敏零检验，可用于探测基于属性的星系组装偏置以及未加权两点聚类所隐藏的次级晕信息。**
summary: We investigate whether luminosity-weighted marked correlation functions can reveal secondary halo information beyond that encoded by halo mass alone, as expected in scenarios of galaxy assembly bias. We propose a controlled null test in which galaxy luminosities follow the same mean luminosity--halo mass relation and scatter, while their residuals are either (A) uncorrelated with secondary halo properties or (B) correlated with a standardized secondary halo property, $s$. Both models have identical halo occupation, galaxy positions, luminosity function, and unweighted projected two-point correlation function, $w_p(r_p)$, so their distinction is encoded entirely in the luminosity marks. At leading order, the projected marked correlation function difference, $Δ\mathcal{M}_p(r_p)$, scales as $ρ^2σ_{\log L}^2ξ_{ss}(r_p)$, where $ρ$ controls the coupling between the luminosity and secondary-property residuals, $σ_{\log L}$ is the scatter in log luminosity at fixed halo mass, and $ξ_{ss}$ describes the spatial correlation of the secondary property. We test this framework using a DESI-BGS mock catalogue over $0.1<z<0.4$. For the injected dependence, we detect a marked-clustering deviation over $0.11<r_p/(h^{-1}\,{\rm Mpc})<1.04$, obtaining $χ^2=30.14$ relative to the null covariance. A one-parameter test rejects the mass-only hypothesis at greater than $5σ$ significance ($p=2.13\times10^{-7}$) for $|ρ|>0.63$. At fixed $σ_{\log L}=0.23$, correlations as weak as $|ρ|\simeq0.52$ remain detectable, with the results stable under variations in the HOD prescription and modelled galaxy selection effects. These results establish luminosity-weighted marked clustering as a sensitive null test for property-based galaxy assembly bias and secondary halo information hidden from unweighted two-point clustering.

title: Validation and Physical Characterization of Seven TESS Exoplanets: A Compact Multi-Planet System and Targets for Atmospheric Spectroscopy
background_knowledge: 系外行星研究的重要范式之一，是利用凌星法寻找并刻画行星：当行星从恒星前方经过时，恒星亮度会出现周期性微弱下降；凌星深度可给出行星半径与恒星半径之比，凌星周期给出轨道周期，再结合恒星参数可推进行星半径、轨道半长轴和平衡温度等估算。TESS 等巡天会产生大量凌星候选体，但其中相当一部分并非真实行星，而可能来自食双星、背景或邻近恒星污染、仪器系统误差等 astrophysical false positive。因此，在开展大气刻画前，需要进行 statistical validation：结合像素级质心变化、Gaia 星表污染分析、贝叶斯推断和误报概率计算，判断候选体是否更可能为行星。常用指标包括 false positive probability（FPP）与 nearby false positive probability（NFPP）。若缺少径向速度或凌星时刻变化等动力学质量测量，可用经验质量—半径关系估计行星质量。对于大气后续观测，透射光谱在行星凌星期间通过比较不同波长的凌星深度来探测大气吸收特征；Transmission Spectroscopy Metrics（TSM）用于综合评估目标进行透射光谱观测的适宜性，JWST 与 Ariel 等设施将优先观测高 TSM 目标。
contribution: 本文对围绕五颗宿主恒星的七颗 TESS 系外行星候选体进行统计验证与物理刻画，并将此前已在文献中验证的亚海王星伴星 TOI-2392.03 纳入分析，作为对自动化筛查与贝叶斯推断流程的一致性检验。研究框架结合自动信号检索、像素级质心与 Gaia DR3 污染分析，以及使用 TRICERATOPS 计算误报概率；物理与轨道参数通过嵌套采样（juliet/Dynesty）推导，并因缺少动力学质量测量而辅以经验质量—半径关系。对全部候选体采用同一流程后，作者统计验证了六颗新系外行星（$\mathrm{FPP} < 0.015$ 且 $\mathrm{NFPP} < 0.001$），其中 **TOI-7721.01 接近 FPP 阈值**。论文还**报告了 TOI-2392 三行星系统的周期比**，并指出 **TOI-7721.01 与 TOI-1277.02 是本样本中 TSM 最高的候选体**，因而是 JWST 及即将运行的 Ariel 任务开展大气后续观测的关注目标。
summary: The Transiting Exoplanet Survey Satellite (TESS) continues to identify thousands of transit candidates that require statistical validation to rule out astrophysical false positives before atmospheric characterization can be pursued. We statistically validate and characterize seven TESS exoplanet candidates orbiting five host stars. As a consistency check of our automated vetting and Bayesian inference pipeline, we include TOI-2392.03, a sub-Neptune companion previously validated in the literature. Our framework combines automated signal retrieval, pixel-level centroid and Gaia DR3 contamination analysis, and false positive probability (FPP) computation with the TRICERATOPS vetting engine. Physical and orbital parameters are derived via nested sampling (juliet/Dynesty), complemented by an empirical mass-radius relation, since no dynamical mass measurements are available. Applying the same procedure to all candidates, we statistically validate six new exoplanets ($\mathrm{FPP} < 0.015$ and $\mathrm{NFPP} < 0.001$), one of which (TOI-7721.01) lies close to the FPP threshold. We report the period ratios of the three-planet system TOI-2392, and identify TOI-7721.01 and TOI-1277.02 as the candidates with the highest Transmission Spectroscopy Metrics (TSM) in our sample, making them targets of interest for atmospheric follow-up with the James Webb Space Telescope (JWST) and the upcoming Ariel mission.

title: Ram Pressure Is Unable to Strip All Phases of the Interstellar Medium out of Spirals Falling into Galaxy Clusters
background_knowledge: 星系团是宇宙中由暗物质主导、包含大量星系与高温低密度团内介质（ICM）的束缚结构。螺旋星系以数百至上千公里每秒的速度落入星系团时，会与 ICM 发生动压相互作用。经典的 Gunn & Gott 判据认为，当 ICM 动压超过星系盘对自身气体的恢复力时，盘中的气体可被冲压剥离（RPS），从而抑制恒星形成并留下尾迹或 wake。实际星系中的星际介质（ISM）是多相的：既有冷而致密的分子云，也有较暖的原子气体与稀薄电离气体；不同密度、温度和尺度上的气体对动压的响应并不相同。除了整体剥离外，云与 ICM 界面还会受 Kelvin-Helmholtz 不稳定性影响，触发湍流黏性剥离（TVS），从云表面逐层带走气体。判断冲压剥离能否移除所有 ISM 相、致密云是否会整体减速，以及尾迹中的细丝结构如何产生，需要三维流体力学计算来追踪激波透射、云形变、动量传递与质量损失。
contribution: 论文重新审视冲压剥离对单个致密云的影响，特别关注由云与 ICM 界面 Kelvin-Helmholtz 不稳定性驱动的 **湍流黏性剥离（TVS）** 对高密度、低温度分子气体的作用。作者指出，延展气体体要整体减速，其迎风面获得的动量必须通过可在内部传播的流体力学扰动传递到整个气体体；随后用三维流体力学计算模拟致密云与 ICM 的相互作用。结果显示：在云数密度 $n_{\mathrm{cl}}=10^{2}\ \mathrm{cm}^{-3}$ 时，经透射激波作用的动压会强烈压缩并改变云形状，但只产生很小的减速；在 $n_{\mathrm{cl}}=10^{3}\ \mathrm{cm}^{-3}$ 时，较慢的透射激波造成的形变更弱。两种密度下，TVS 都持续从云表面剥离气体，并形成在形态上难以区分、质量损失率相当的尾迹。由此表明，**作用于单个致密云的 TVS 可在水母星系尾迹中产生细丝状子结构**，也意味着 **RPS 难以一次性剥离螺旋星系中所有相态的 ISM**。
summary: Following the expansion of the Universe, spiral galaxies may fall at large speeds into galaxy clusters. Their interaction with the intracluster medium (ICM) may remove part of their gas and reduce their capacity for making new stars, as envisaged by Gunn & Gott. Ram pressure stripping (RPS) is commonly invoked to explain this gas loss and the wakes or tails left behind in-falling galaxies. Here we revise the impact of RPS on individual dense clouds and particularly focus on turbulent viscous stripping (TVS), driven by Kelvin-Helmholtz instabilities at the cloud-ICM interface, that affects the high-density and low-temperature molecular gas. For an extended gaseous body to decelerate, momentum from its exposed surface must be communicated into the gas by a hydrodynamic disturbance able to propagate through it. Three-dimensional hydrodynamic calculations follow this interaction with dense clouds. At cloud number densities $n_{\mathrm{cl}}=10^2$ cm$^{-3}$, ram pressure acting through the transmitted shock strongly compresses and deforms the cloud and produces only a small deceleration; at $n_{\mathrm{cl}}=10^3$ cm$^{-3}$, the slower transmitted shock produces much weaker deformation. At both cloud densities, TVS continuously removes gas from the cloud surface and forms qualitatively indistinguishable trailing wakes, with comparable mass-loss rates, suggesting that TVS acting on individual dense clouds can generate filamentary substructure within jellyfish-galaxy tails.

title: Dynamics of spinning supermassive black hole binaries: I. A direct $N$-body study
background_knowledge: 超大质量黑洞双星通常形成于星系并合后的星系核区：两个黑洞先通过动力摩擦向中心下沉，形成束缚双星，再在致密恒星环境中通过三体散射不断把恒星踢出并缩小轨道，这一过程称为硬化（hardening）。恒星散射效率、轨道偏心率以及双星与恒星之间的能量分配，共同决定双星并合时标；在轨道足够靠近后，引力波辐射接替成为主导并合机制。黑洞自旋可通过自旋-轨道和自旋-自旋耦合引入相对论修正，改变近距离轨道演化与散射细节。直接 $N$ 体积分并耦合后牛顿（PN）项，是检验这些效应的重要数值途径，但计算代价高，且必须严格控制能量误差。
contribution: 论文对质量分别为 $m_1=3\times10^8\,M_\odot$ 和 $m_2=8\times10^7\,M_\odot$、质量比 $q\simeq3.75$ 的超大质量黑洞双星进行直接 $N$ 体模拟，在黑洞-黑洞相互作用中计入最高 2.5 PN 阶的后牛顿修正，比较包括无自旋模型在内的 7 种自旋构型，并考察数值分辨率对转移给恒星能量的影响。结果表明，在所采用初条件下，不同自旋构型的并合时间仅围绕约 3.8 Myr 的总旋近时标变化 1.7%；硬化率与累积转移能量随自旋构型仅呈温和且非单调的差异，未显示对自旋大小或方向的系统性依赖。恒星获得的能量与同一批相遇中双星损失的能量（包括引力波辐射）在约 1% 内相符，给出了能量收支的误差水平。约四分之三的累积能量增益来自顺行恒星轨道，但该偏好也存在于无自旋模型，因而不能归因于黑洞自旋。**因此，对本文双星参数与恒星模型，自旋对整体并合时标和能量重分配的全局影响有限，恒星相互作用仍是硬化过程的核心。**
summary: The dynamical evolution of supermassive black hole (SMBH) binaries in dense stellar environments may be influenced by the individual and mutual spin configurations of the black hole through spin-orbit and spin-spin couplings. We investigate the impact of spin on key dynamical properties, including binary hardening, orbital evolution, and energy exchange with the surrounding stellar population of an SMBH binary with masses $m_1=3\cdot10^8\,M_\odot$ and $m_2=8\cdot10^7\,M_\odot$, corresponding to a mass ratio $q\simeq3.75$. We perform direct $N$-body simulations including post-Newtonian (PN) corrections up to 2.5PN order between the black hole-black hole interactions, considering seven spin configurations, including a non-spinning model, and examine the effects of numerical resolution on the energy transferred to the stars. For the adopted initial conditions, the binary merger times vary only by $1.7\%$ of the $\sim3.8$ Myr total inspiral time. The hardening rates and cumulative energy transferred to the stellar population also show modest, non-monotonic variations across the spin configurations, with no clear systematic dependence on spin magnitude or orientation. The energy gained by the stars is consistent with the corresponding energy lost by the binary during the same encounters, including that radiated in gravitational waves, to within approximately $1\%$, which sets the level of the energy error of the balance. We further find that prograde stellar orbits account for roughly three quarters of the cumulative energy gain, a preference that is also present in the non-spinning model and therefore cannot be attributed to black-hole spin. Our results indicate that, for the binary parameters and stellar model considered here, spin has a limited influence on the global merger timescale and overall energy redistribution, while stellar interactions remain central to the hardening process.

title: Feature redundancy, redshift, and class-prior effects in SDSS--WISE photometric classification
background_knowledge: 在成像巡天中，星系、类星体和恒星会同时被探测到。它们的多波段测光（尤其是光学到中红外颜色）反映了不同的物理起源：恒星以恒星大气与吸收线为主，星系包含恒星、气体和尘埃的复合辐射，类星体则由黑洞吸积盘及尘埃环主导，因而在 SDSS 光学与 WISE 中红外颜色空间中占据不同区域。测光分类的任务是利用星等、颜色、形态和误差等特征，把海量测光源分为恒星、星系和类星体，为后续统计、选源和光谱 follow-up 提供基础。传统上依赖颜色选择（color cuts）；现代研究多用监督机器学习，以光谱证认样本为训练集，比较不同特征工程与分类器。该领域的核心难点包括：训练标签来自有限且非随机的光谱样本，目标样本的类别先验可能不同；测光误差、银河消光和星等限制会造成分布偏移；红移既是重要物理量，也可能通过训练样本的选择与泄漏影响分类；内部测光红移（photo-$z$）常由同一组测光特征导出，可能与分类特征冗余，外部 photo-$z$ 则可能补充独立信息。评价时需区分总体准确率与按类别的纯度/完备度，宏平均 $F_1$ 对稀有类更敏感；还必须报告类别先验、按红移分层的表现、特征消融和跨巡天泛化，避免把选择效应误读为物理分类能力。
contribution: 论文在 365 万个 SDSS DR17–WISE 源上系统分离特征、光谱红移、类别先验和评价样本四个因素，训练五种分类器并比较十二种特征方案，结合四种特征排序方法、仅原始特征基线、分组重要性、配对 bootstrap 检验、显式先验、星等偏移以及 WISE/红移消融。含光谱红移时，调优 Random Forest 达到宏平均 $F_1=0.9834$；去除光谱红移后，10 个原始特征的宏平均 $F_1$ 为 0.9507，24 个特征为 0.9551。**红移占置换重要性的 80.1%，但混合了物理信息与选择效应：在 $1.5 \le z < 2$ 的 GALAXY 召回率，含红移时为 0.016，不含红移时为 0.68。** 内部 photo-$z$ 仅使宏平均 $F_1$ 变化 $\pm 0.0001$，本质上是冗余的；外部 photo-$z$ 带来 $+0.006$ 至 $+0.009$ 的提升。含红移时工程特征贡献可忽略；不含红移时，增益完全来自颜色。**红移是依赖巡天的信号；内部 photo-$z$ 冗余，外部 photo-$z$ 的增益有限且有条件。** 作者建议在明确先验下报告纯度/完备度、按红移分层的各类召回率、WISE/红移消融及独立巡天检验；结果受 SDSS–WISE 选择限制，更深巡天需要重新标定或重新训练。
summary: Photometric classification of galaxies, quasars, and stars is important for future imaging surveys, but reported performance depends on the engineered features, spectroscopic redshift, class priors, and the sample used for evaluation. We separate these four factors on 3.65 million SDSS DR17--WISE sources, train five classifiers on twelve feature scenarios. We combine a four-method feature ranking, raw-only baselines, grouped importance, and a paired bootstrap, with explicit priors, magnitude shifts, and WISE/redshift ablations. With spectroscopic redshift the tuned Random Forest reaches a macro-$F_1$ of $0.9834$; without it, 10 raw features give $0.9507$ and 24 features $0.9551$. Redshift accounts for $80.1\%$ of the permutation importance but mixes physics with selection: GALAXY recall at $1.5\le z<2$ is $0.016$ with redshift and $0.68$ without. An internal photo-$z$ changes macro-$F_1$ by only $\pm0.0001$ (necessarily redundant); an external one adds $+0.006$ to $+0.009$. Engineered features are negligible with redshift; without it, gains come entirely from colours. Redshift is a survey-dependent signal. Internal photo-$z$ is redundant; external gains are modest and conditional. We recommend reporting purity/completeness under explicit priors, per-class recall versus redshift, WISE/redshift ablations, and independent-survey tests. Results are bounded by SDSS--WISE selection; deeper surveys require recalibration or retraining.

title: Disentangling star formation rate indicators in H-ATLAS galaxies: UV, FIR and radio diagnostics from energy-balance SED fitting
background_knowledge:
星系中的恒星形成主要发生在冷分子云中，大质量年轻恒星发出强烈的紫外（UV）辐射，但其中很大一部分被尘埃吸收并在红外（FIR）再辐射；射电同步辐射则来自超新星遗迹加速的宇宙线电子，因而与近期恒星形成活动间接相关。不同波段提供了互补但受不同系统效应影响的恒星形成率（SFR）示踪：UV 需进行尘埃衰减改正，FIR 反映被尘埃吸收的总能量并受尘埃温度与几何影响，1.4 GHz 射电受宇宙线、磁场、电子能谱及 AGN 污染影响，并常用红外—射电相关 $q_{\rm IR}$ 来检验。
\n该领域的研究范式是对多波段测光进行 SED 拟合：设定恒星形成历史、年龄、金属丰度、尘埃衰减曲线，并施加能量平衡，使被吸收的星光能量等于尘埃再辐射能量，从而自洽地得到衰减、尘埃光度、恒星质量和 SFR。H-ATLAS 等 Herschel 巡天提供 FIR 数据，结合 UV、光学与射电数据可系统比较不同 SFR 示踪法。实际分析还需处理红移、K 改正、AGN 排除、射电上限和测光误差，并注意样本选择效应。
contribution: 论文对 H-ATLAS Data Release 1 星表中 $N_{\rm samp}$ 个星系（中位红移 0.12）比较了 FUV、FIR 与 1.4 GHz 射电三种 SFR 示踪，样本剔除类星体、AGN 主导星系和不可靠红移。作者用 \textsc{cigale} 进行能量平衡 SED 拟合，自洽获得衰减、尘埃光度和 SFR。**FUV 衰减与 FIR 光度强相关（Spearman $\rho=0.84$）**，其中相当部分来自二者共同的红移依赖（固定 $z$ 时偏相关 $\rho=0.57$），而与红外超出（IRX）的关系更紧（$\rho=0.96$）。对于 67% 的星系，未改正的 UV SFR 比 FIR SFR 低十倍以上；所有 $A_{\rm FUV}>4$ mag 的星系均如此。714 个星系的 FIRST 1.4 GHz 流量处于噪声水平，被作为上限处理；若误作探测，拟合会给出不切实际的低尘埃温度。84 个射电探测的中位 $q_{\rm IR}$ 为 2.51，接近假设值 2.58。10 Myr 与 100 Myr 平均 SFR 相差小于 2%，因为模型恒星形成历史较平滑。由于缺乏高性能计算资源，全部星系均在 $z=0$ 拟合并对距离相关量重标；这使拟合所得尘埃温度约降低为原来的 $1/(1+z)$，并偏置恒星质量以及在 $z>0.2$ 时的衰减，但尘埃光度和 SFR 仅变化约百分之几 dex。每个星系使用 1630 万个模型，展示了在普通硬件上开展 UV 到射电 SED 建模所能得到的结果。
summary: We compare three star formation rate (SFR) tracers --- far-ultraviolet (FUV), far-infrared (FIR) and 1.4\,GHz radio emission --- for \Nsamp\ galaxies (median redshift 0.12) from the Herschel Astrophysical Terahertz Large Area Survey Data Release 1 catalogue, excluding quasars, AGN-dominated galaxies and unreliable redshifts. Energy-balance spectral energy distribution fitting with \textsc{cigale} gives their attenuations, dust luminosities and SFRs self-consistently. The FUV attenuation correlates strongly with FIR luminosity (Spearman $ρ=0.84$), largely through their common dependence on redshift (partial $ρ=0.57$ at fixed $z$), and more tightly with the infrared excess ($ρ=0.96$). The uncorrected UV SFR is over ten times below the FIR SFR for 67 per cent of the galaxies, and for all with $A_{\rm FUV}>4$\,mag. For 714 galaxies the FIRST 1.4\,GHz flux density is at the noise level and is treated as an upper limit; as detections, these values push the fits to unrealistically low dust temperatures. The 84 radio detections have a median $q_{\rm IR}$ of 2.51, close to the assumed 2.58. SFRs averaged over 10 and 100\,Myr differ by under 2 per cent, because the model star formation histories are smooth. Without access to high-performance computing, all galaxies were fitted at $z=0$, with distance-dependent quantities rescaled. This lowers dust temperatures by a factor of about $(1+z)$ and biases stellar masses and, at $z>0.2$, attenuations, but changes dust luminosities and SFRs by only a few hundredths of a dex. These fits, with 16.3 million models per galaxy, show what UV-to-radio SED modelling can deliver on modest hardware.

title: The Silk Nebula Revisited: A Comment on Wu et al. (2026) and New Constraints from Archival Survey Spectroscopy
background_knowledge: 银河系星际介质呈多相结构，包括冷分子云、中性氢、温暖电离介质（WIM）与热等离子体。弥漫电离气体常通过 Hα、[N II] λ6583、[O III] λ5007、[O II] 及 Hβ 等发射线探测；其速度质心、线宽和线比可用于区分光致电离、激波加热与超新星遗迹（SNR）等机制。观测上须做日心速度改正、识别人造与大气辉线，并用 rayleigh 等单位比较表面亮度。多波段数据（GALEX 紫外、X 射线、H I、尘埃）和诊断图是判断电离源与激波性质的标准范式。
contribution: 本文针对 Wu et al. (2026) 基于单块 LAMOST MRS-N 光谱板提出的 Silk 星云（双子座中长约 $17^{\circ}$ 的 [O III] λ5007 纤维状结构）可能与约 160 pc 处 SNR 成协的结论，利用其发表值与独立档案数据进行检验。作者指出其蓝臂光谱中的 Ni 大气辉线位于大气、以观测者为参考的静止波长，故 [O III] 速度未做日心改正，系统性偏高 $10.1 \pm 1.0\ \mathrm{km\,s^{-1}}$。改正并联合 DESI DR1 与 SDSS 光谱后，[O III] 的 $v_{\mathrm{hel}} = +13.3 \pm 1.0\ \mathrm{km\,s^{-1}}$，与 [N II] 及本地 WIM 速度一致；其 Hα 速度比 [N II] 红 4.5–6.7 km s⁻¹。其表中距离单位是 kpc 而非 100 pc，且该方向运动学距离无有效信息；表面亮度比独立测量（1.4–2.5 rayleigh）高 4.6–8.6 倍；红线激波判据在无星云背景区同样满足并描述 WIM，其他遗迹诊断不能约束该纤维。DESI/SDSS 显示该纤维 Balmer 线弱（[O III]/Hβ > 11）、[O II] 强、He II/[O III] < 0.026；GALEX 有重合紫外脊，但无 Hα、H I、尘埃或 X 射线对应体。结合缺乏电离源，这些性质排除光致电离平衡与完整辐射激波，**更符合侧视的、速度约 80–120 km s⁻¹ 的柱截断辐射激波，并可能位于约 250–320 pc 的 Monogem Ring 边缘**。作者提出远紫外与深光学光谱、两历元自行及沿夹持白矮星方向的高电离吸收是决定性检验。
summary: Wu et al. (2026) used one LAMOST MRS-N plate to suggest that the Silk Nebula, a $17^\circ$-long \Oiii~$λ$5007 filament in Gemini, is possibly associated with a supernova remnant at a fiducial distance of $\sim$160\,pc. We test this against their published values and independent archival data. The \Ni\ airglow in their blue-arm spectrum lies at air, topocentric rest wavelengths, so their \Oiii\ velocities omit the heliocentric correction and are $10.1\pm1.0$\,\kms\ too high. Corrected and combined with DESI DR1 and SDSS spectra, \Oiii\ lies at \vhel\ $=+13.3\pm1.0$\,\kms, the velocity of \Nii\ and of the local warm ionized medium (WIM). Their \Ha\ velocities are 4.5--6.7\,\kms\ redder than \Nii. Their tabulated distances are in kpc, not units of 100\,pc, and kinematic distances carry no information in this direction. Their surface brightness exceeds independent measurements (1.4--2.5 rayleighs) by factors of 4.6--8.6. Their red-line shock criteria are met equally in their nebula-free background region and describe the WIM; their other remnant diagnostics do not constrain the filament. DESI and SDSS spectra show that the filament is Balmer-dark (\Oiii/\Hb\ $>11$) and \Oii-strong, with \ion{He}{2}/\Oiii\ $<0.026$; GALEX shows a coincident ultraviolet ridge, with no \Ha, \ion{H}{1}, dust or X-ray counterpart. These properties, and the lack of an ionizing source, exclude photoionization equilibrium and complete radiative shocks and match a column-truncated radiative shock of $\sim$80--120\,\kms\ seen edge-on, plausibly on the limb of the Monogem Ring at $\sim$250--320\,pc. Far-ultraviolet and deep optical spectroscopy, a two-epoch proper motion and high-ion absorption toward bracketing white dwarfs would be decisive.

title: Sourcing vector perturbations in warm inflation through shear viscous effects
background_knowledge: 宇宙暴胀是极早期宇宙经历的一次近指数加速膨胀，被用来解释宇宙微波背景的大尺度均匀性与平直性，并为主流结构形成理论提供近标度不变的初始扰动。宇宙学扰动通常按空间旋转性质分解为标量模、矢量模和张量模：标量模对应密度扰动，是宇宙微波背景各向异性与大尺度结构的主要种子；张量模对应原初引力波；矢量模对应旋转型速度扰动或各向异性应力。在理想流体近似下，矢量模没有源项，并随宇宙膨胀快速衰减，因此在标准扰动理论中通常被忽略。warm inflation（温膨胀）则假设暴胀子与辐射浴存在持续相互作用，耗散与随机涨落使辐射浴处于非平衡状态，可能产生黏滞效应，尤其是剪切黏滞所对应的各向异性应力，使系统不能再用完美流体描述。研究这类非平衡随机流体效应，有助于检验矢量模是否可能在暴胀期间被持续激发，并理解其对早期宇宙扰动谱的潜在影响。
contribution: 论文采用涨落流体力学方法，引入由剪切黏滞产生的随机各向异性应力，研究 warm inflation 中矢量扰动的来源问题。作者证明，在暴胀背景中矢量模满足一个受约束的 Langevin 方程；在弱黏滞区域，其功率谱 **正比于剪切黏滞系数**，并依赖于 Hubble 慢滚参数 $ε$，近似按 $a^{-(1-ε)}$ 衰减。该衰减 **显著慢于无源、无黏滞情形下的 $a^{-4}$ 衰减**，表明剪切黏滞可以持续为矢量模提供源。尽管如此，被持续激发的矢量模在超视界尺度上仍会衰减；数值示例中的基准参数选择给出 **可忽略的晚期矢量—标量比**。因此，尽管没有直接的大尺度可观测矢量信号，论文的主要结果仍 **确立了 warm inflation 期间的一种矢量扰动源**，并为研究矢量通道中的次级效应以及大尺度白噪声提供了框架。
summary: Vector modes are generally believed not to play a significant role in standard cosmological perturbation theory because they decay rapidly. Non-equilibrium dynamics in the radiation bath present during warm inflation can lead to shear viscous effects, requiring a description beyond the perfect-fluid approximation. We adopt the fluctuating hydrodynamic approach to account for stochastic anisotropic stress related to shear viscosity. We show that the vector mode obeys a constrained Langevin equation in an inflationary background. The resulting power spectrum, considered in the weak-viscosity regime, is proportional to the shear viscosity and it also depends on the Hubble slow-roll parameter $ε$, decaying approximately as $a^{-(1-ε)}$. This behaviour is significantly slower than the unsourced, non-viscous power spectrum, which decays as $a^{-4}$. The continuously sourced vector modes, nevertheless, decay on superhorizon scales, and the illustrative benchmark parameter choices adopted in our numerical examples give a negligible late-time vector-to-scalar ratio. Despite the absence of direct large-scale observable vector signatures, the main results establish a source of vector perturbations during warm inflation and provide a framework for studying possible secondary effects along with large-scale white noises in the vector channel.

title: Calibrating the cosmic distance ladder for independent dark energy constraints
background_knowledge: 现代宇宙学的基本图像是：宇宙的膨胀历史由物质、辐射、空间曲率与暗能量共同决定，而暗能量通常用状态方程 $w = p_{\mathrm{DE}}/\rho_{\mathrm{DE}}$ 描述；$\Lambda$CDM 模型对应 $w=-1$，但若暗能量随时间演化，常写成 $w(z)=w_0+w_a z/(1+z)$ 等形式。探测暗能量主要依赖多探针联合：宇宙微波背景辐射给出早期宇宙几何与声学尺度，重子声学振荡（BAO）提供标准尺，Ia 型超新星（SN Ia）则作为可标准化的标准烛光，通过 Hubble 图测量距离模数 $\mu = 5\log_{10}(d_L/10\,\mathrm{pc})$ 随红移的变化。\n\nSN Ia 宇宙学的核心范式是：用光变曲线形状、颜色等修正其峰值亮度，得到标准化后的距离，再与红移比较以限制宇宙膨胀历史和暗能量参数。该过程构成宇宙距离阶梯的一部分，其关键系统误差包括光度定标、滤光片透过率、定标星表、尘埃消光、样本选择与本征弥散等。近年来，DESI 等巡天的 BAO 结果与 SN Ia 样本联合后，在允许暗能量状态方程随时间变化时出现对 $\Lambda$CDM 的偏离；因此，独立且高精度定标的低红移 SN Ia 样本、以及跨巡天的系统误差控制，成为检验暗能量演化的重要研究方向。
contribution: 论文围绕暗能量约束中的宇宙距离阶梯定标展开。DESI 合作组近期结果显示，在允许暗能量状态方程随时间变化时，结果偏离 $\Lambda$CDM；这一偏离强烈依赖于 Ia 型超新星巡天，而这些巡天目前共享同一低红移样本。ZTF 巡天提供当前更大的低红移 Ia 型超新星样本，可显著提升限制能力。在此背景下，LEMAITRE 合作组旨在利用 **ZTF、SNLS 与 HSC 三套相互独立的 Ia 型超新星数据集** 给出新的暗能量参数约束。为此，核心工作是实现稳健的光度定标，重点关注滤光片透过率测量与星表定标，目标是把距离模数上的定标系统误差控制在 **0.4% 以下**，从而为独立暗能量约束提供可靠的光度定标基础。
summary: Recent cosmological results presented by the DESI collaboration show a clear deviation from the $Λ$CDM model when considering a time-dependent dark energy equation of state. This deviation is strongly driven by the SNe Ia surveys, which all share the same low redshift sample. The ZTF survey provides the current larger SNe Ia sample at low redshift, which will significantly increase the constraining power. In this context, the LEMAITRE collaboration aims to provide new constraints on dark energy parameters using three independent SNe Ia datasets: ZTF, SNLS and HSC. This effort requires robust photometric calibration, with a particular focus on filter transmission measurement and star catalog calibration. The target for LEMAITRE is to control the calibration systematics on distance moduli below 0.4%.

title: Star-forming disc galaxies align tangentially with the cosmic tidal field
background_knowledge: 宇宙大尺度结构由引力不稳定性增长形成，物质分布呈现节点、纤维和空洞组成的宇宙网。宇宙潮汐场是引力势 $\Phi$ 的二阶导数张量 $T_{ij} = \partial_i \partial_j \Phi$ 的各向异性部分，描述局部物质被拉伸或压缩的方向，是连接大尺度环境和星系形成的重要物理量。星系的本征形状与角动量受形成历史和原初潮汐力矩影响，因此星系的空间取向并非随机，而会与周围大尺度结构相关，这称为本征排列（intrinsic alignment）。在弱引力透镜中，前景星系的本征排列会污染背景星系的剪切信号，是宇宙剪切测量的主要系统误差之一；同时，本征排列也是研究星系形成和宇宙网环境的观测量。观测上，红色早型星系常显示围绕其他星系的径向排列，而蓝色恒星形成盘星系长期缺乏显著排列证据。经典潮汐力矩理论将盘星系角动量来源归于潮汐场施加的力矩，并对排列统计作出可检验预测；区分对潮汐场的线性响应与高斯潮汐场中的纯二次响应，是检验该框架的关键。
contribution: 论文将 SPHEREx 分光光度测量与 DESI Legacy Imaging Surveys 结合，构建了覆盖全天、包含 7100 万个星系且具有精确红移的星表，并在此基础上按颜色和形态划分样本，系统测量星系形状排列信号。主要结果是：**蓝色盘星系（恒星形成星系）相对周围结构呈现切向排列，显著性为 $22.5\sigma$；红色椭球星系呈现径向排列，显著性为 $65\sigma$**。作者进一步分别测量高密度区和低密度区周围的排列信号，发现这两类排列的尺度依赖和环境依赖均符合对宇宙潮汐场的线性响应；**这排除了高斯潮汐场中纯二次响应的解释，即经典潮汐力矩理论所预期的纯二次排列图像不能完整描述观测**。该工作为星系本征排列的物理机制提供了强约束，也对弱引力透镜宇宙学中的系统误差建模具有重要意义。
summary: The alignments of galaxy shapes, with one another and with the large-scale structure of the Universe, have been a topic of considerable investigation within cosmology and extragalactic astrophysics for the last 60 years. Galaxy alignments are a major systematic for weak gravitational lensing and help us learn about the processes of galaxy formation. Red early-type galaxies are known to show strong radial alignments around other galaxies; however, blue star-forming galaxies have shown little evidence of alignment. We combine SPHEREx spectrophotometry with DESI Legacy Imaging Surveys to build a full-sky catalogue of 71 million galaxies with precise redshifts. With this catalogue we are able to measure alignment signals by splitting galaxies into colour and morphological samples. We detect tangential alignment of blue disc galaxies at $22.5σ$ and radial alignment of red spheroidal galaxies at $65σ$. By measuring the alignment signal separately around overdensities and underdensities, we show that each of these alignments has the scale and environmental dependence of a linear response to the cosmic tidal field; a response purely quadratic in the Gaussian tidal field, as in classic tidal torque theory is ruled out.

title: Inhomogeneous Cutoff Regularization of Loops in Cosmological Correlators
background_knowledge: 宇宙学关联函数是连接早期宇宙量子涨落与晚期大尺度结构的核心观测量。在暴胀图像中，标量与张量扰动从真空量子涨落产生，并被拉伸到超视界；其两点函数、三点函数及更高阶关联函数编码了暴胀动力学、场内容与相互作用。计算这些关联函数的圈修正需要对内部动量积分，积分通常含紫外发散，因此必须引入正则化与重整化。截断正则化直观但会显式破坏尺度对称性，并可能在长波背景存在时把正则化伪影混入物理结果。超视界长波模式可视为局域背景：在分离宇宙图像中，不同空间区域各自近似为独立的 FRW 宇宙，局域膨胀与空间重标度由长波扰动决定。由此，物理截断应当相对于局域几何而非全局背景定义。另一方面，残余规范/微分同胚对称性给出软模一致性关系，而曲率扰动在超视界上的守恒性保证了功率谱的晚期常定性。如何在截断正则化下同时保持这些性质，是宇宙学圈图计算中的关键问题。
contribution: 本文重新审视宇宙学关联函数圈图计算中的截断正则化。作者主张，对应于固定物理尺度的截断必须相对于局域背景几何来定义；在存在超视界扰动时，这可在分离宇宙图像中自然实现，即不同局域区域在同一物理尺度上被正则化。把该截断按长波背景展开，会产生一系列由正则化器诱导的圈振幅贡献，并可将这些贡献图解为对相应圈收缩的长波模式插入。该方案保持残余空间伸缩变换与保体积的各向异性重标度不变，因此特别适用于含软外模的圈关联函数。作者通过计算超视界尺度上一圈标量与张量功率谱的贡献来展示机制：**由非均匀截断诱导的额外修正会抵消普通圈图中出现的紫外边界项**，从而在截断正则化框架内确立两种功率谱的晚期常定性并澄清其物理起源。随后，作者研究挤压极限下的一圈标量双谱，发现**额外截断贡献对于在有限截断下满足一致性关系不可或缺**；最后讨论了非均匀截断在一圈双谱晚期常定性中的作用。
summary: We revisit the use of cutoff regularization in computing loop corrections to cosmological correlators. We argue that a cutoff corresponding to a fixed physical scale must be defined with respect to the local background geometry. In the presence of superhorizon perturbations, this is naturally implemented within the separate universe picture, where different local patches are regulated at the same physical scale. Expanding this cutoff in the long-wavelength background generates a series of regulator-induced contributions to loop amplitudes, which admit a diagrammatic interpretation as long-mode insertions on the corresponding loop contractions. Our cutoff prescription preserves residual spatial dilatations and volume-preserving anisotropic rescalings. It is therefore particularly relevant for loop correlators with soft external modes. We illustrate the mechanism by computing the contributions to the one-loop scalar and tensor power spectra on superhorizon scales. In both cases, the additional corrections induced by the inhomogeneous cutoff cancel the ultraviolet boundary terms arising in the ordinary diagrams. These calculations establish, within cutoff regularization, the late-time constancy of both power spectra and clarify its physical origin. We then investigate the squeezed one-loop scalar bispectrum and show that the additional cutoff contributions are essential for satisfying the consistency relation at finite cutoff. Finally, we discuss the role of the inhomogeneous cutoff in the late-time constancy of the one-loop bispectrum.

title: Gamma-Ray Pulsar Discovery Using a Lattice-Based Method
background_knowledge: 脉冲星是高速自转、强磁场的中子星，其磁层会产生定向的射电、X 射线和 $\gamma$ 射线辐射。对于 $\gamma$ 射线脉冲星而言，Fermi-LAT 等望远镜记录的是一个个光子的到达时间和方向；当辐射束扫过地球时，到达时间序列中隐含自转周期及周期变化。问题在于 $\gamma$ 射线光子极其稀疏：典型情况下约每 $10^8$ 次自转才探测到一个光子，因此周期性被大量空缺掩盖。传统搜索需在频率、频率导数乃至双星轨道参数构成的高维参数空间中做相干或半相干折叠与穷举，计算量随维度和精度迅速增长；半相干方法虽能处理部分相位失配，但在极稀疏、长观测和高参数维度下仍可能昂贵到不可行。近年来，格点方法把周期信号识别转化为在高维格点中寻找短向量，可利用高效格点算法避免穷举扫描，为大规模时域天文搜索提供了新范式。
contribution: 论文报告了**首颗利用格点方法扩展算法发现的 $\gamma$ 射线脉冲星**。该方法以高维格点中的短向量识别替代对周期信号的穷举搜索。研究者在 15 年 Fermi-LAT 数据中发现了 PSR J1622$-$7204：一颗自转频率为 261 Hz 的孤立脉冲星，搜索仅耗时约 10 CPU 小时。作为对比，此前最先进的半相干搜索在约 600 CPU 年后仍未成功。**这一结果表明：格点搜索在极稀疏光子条件下具有显著计算优势**，并有望用于发现更多新的 $\gamma$ 射线脉冲星，包括双星系统中的脉冲星；而在缺乏详细轨道先验知识时，后一类搜索此前几乎难以处理。
summary: Pulsars are difficult to discover via $γ$-ray pulsations because typically only one photon is observed per ${\sim}10^8$ rotations. We report the first $γ$-ray pulsar discovered with an extension of a recently proposed algorithm, which uses efficient tools for identifying short vectors in high-dimensional lattices instead of exhaustively searching for periodic signals. PSR J1622$-$7204, an isolated pulsar spinning at 261 Hz, was found in 15 years of Fermi-LAT data using about ten CPU hours. In contrast, the previous state-of-the-art (a semicoherent search) failed after ${\sim}600$ CPU years. This new approach may enable the discovery of many new $γ$-ray pulsars, including in binary systems, a previously intractable problem without detailed prior knowledge of the orbital parameters.

title: On the feasibility of using [Eu/$α$] to identify accreted and in-situ extragalactic globular clusters
background_knowledge: 球状星团是星系中古老、束缚紧密的恒星系统，可视为星系组装历史的“化石”。在等级结构形成框架下，星系通过原位恒星形成与吸积/并合外部星系共同成长；区分原位（in-situ）与吸积（ex-situ）恒星或星团是星系考古的核心问题。化学丰度比 $\mathrm{[X/Y]}$ 记录不同核合成来源与恒星形成历史：α 元素（如 Si、Mg、Ca）主要由核心坍缩超新星贡献，Eu 主要由快中子俘获（r-过程）站点产生，因而 $\mathrm{[Eu/\alpha]}$ 对恒星形成时标、初始质量函数及并合历史敏感。吸积矮星系通常恒星形成效率较低、化学演化较慢，可能保留较高 $\mathrm{[Eu/\alpha]}$；而大质量星系原位快速演化群体倾向较低 $\mathrm{[Eu/\alpha]}$。球状星团积分光光谱可在远距离测量这些丰度，将本地宇宙的化学模式用于河外星系考古。M31、M33 及本星系群（Local Group）矮星系为检验该判据提供了理想实验室。
contribution: 论文利用 28 个球状星团（GCs）的高质量、均一积分光丰度样本（其中 21 个为河外、7 个为银河系）检验 $\mathrm{[Eu/\alpha]}$ 作为原位/吸积群体判据在银河系外的适用性。结果显示，M31 中金属富集（$\mathrm{[Fe/H]}>-0.7$）的 GCs 具有一致的偏低 $\mathrm{[Eu/Si]}\sim-0.4$，**表明它们属于原位群体**；较低金属丰度的 M31 GCs 一般具有较高 $\mathrm{[Eu/Si]}\sim+0.4$，**暗示其起源于被吸积的前身星系，且这些 GCs 位于更大的 M31 投影半径处**。作者进一步将 M31 GCs 的 Na、Mg、Si、Ti、Ca、Eu、Cr、Mn、Ba、Ni、Cu 丰度与 M31 核球比较：原位 M31 GCs 与核球除 Ba（以及可能的 Cr、Ti）外趋势相似，**提示二者经历了相似的恒星形成过程**；M31 核球的 $\mathrm{[Eu/Si]}$ 与银河系原位恒星一致，但高于 M31 原位 GCs。对 M33 和中等质量矮星系，作者识别出原位与吸积 GCs 的混合；对较低质量矮星系则主要识别出原位 GCs。总体而言，**大质量星系中的吸积 GCs 至少部分来自中等质量、中等金属丰度的前身星系**。工作支持 $\mathrm{[Eu/\alpha]}$ 是河外 GCs 原位/吸积区分的强有力指标，并展示了高分辨率积分光丰度用于河外考古的潜力。
summary: The chemical abundance ratio [Eu/$α$] has been proposed as a discriminator between ex-situ and in-situ stellar populations in the Milky Way and external galaxies. Here we show with a high-quality, homogeneous dataset of integrated-light abundances for 28 globular clusters (GCs), where 21 are extragalactic and 7 galactic, that this behaviour holds in other Local Group galaxies. In particular, we find metal-rich ([Fe/H] > --0.7) M31 GCs have uniformly low [Eu/Si]$\sim-0.4$, indicating they represent an in-situ population. Lower metallicity GCs in M31 generally show high [Eu/Si] $\sim+0.4$, suggesting they originated in accreted progenitors, and these GCs lie at larger projected radii from the M31 centre. Furthermore, we compare the M31 GC abundances with similar determinations for the M31 bulge for Na, Mg, Si, Ti, Ca, Eu, Cr, Mn, Ba, Ni, and Cu. The in-situ M31 GCs and M31 bulge exhibit similar abundance trends, excepting Ba -- and possibly Cr and Ti, suggesting similar star formation processes. [Eu/Si] in the M31 bulge is consistent with in-situ Milky Way stars, but is higher than the M31 in-situ GCs. For M33 and intermediate-mass dwarf galaxies, we identify a mixture of in-situ and ex-situ GCs, while for lower-mass dwarfs, we identify primarily in-situ GCs. These results suggest that accreted GCs in massive galaxies originated, at least in part, from intermediate-mass, intermediate-metallicity progenitors. We support earlier suggestions that [Eu/$α$] is a powerful in-/ex-situ separator for extragalactic GCs, demonstrating the potential of high-resolution integrated-light abundances for extragalactic archaeology.

title: Neutral hydrogen in the Shapley Supercluster core II. Gas content and star formation in the filaments connecting the core
background_knowledge: 星系形成与演化研究关注暗物质晕中的重子气体如何冷却、凝聚并形成恒星，以及恒星形成、反馈和环境过程如何共同塑造星系的质量、形态、颜色与气体含量。观测上常用恒星形成主序（SFMS）描述恒星形成星系在恒星质量与恒星形成率之间的紧密关系，并用红序（red sequence）、绿谷/过渡区（transition zone）和气体耗尽时标 $t_{\rm dep}$ 等指标刻画星系从活跃恒星形成向宁静状态的转变。环境是关键因素：星系落入星系团时，会穿越高温、高速度弥散的团内介质，经历冲压剥离、窒息、潮汐扰动和星系并合等过程，导致冷气体被移除、加热或不再补充，恒星形成逐渐停止；在星系团外围和连接团中心的宇宙网纤维中，密度较低但仍可能存在预处理，星系可能先失去部分气体再入团。中性原子氢（HI）的 21 cm 谱线直接示踪冷原子气体储库，是理解气体耗尽和恒星形成效率的核心观测量；MeerKAT 等射电干涉阵列的深度巡测使在近邻超星系团中系统比较团中心、纤维和场星系成为可能。
contribution: 论文利用 MeerKAT L 波段对 Shapley Supercluster（SSC，$z=0.048$）五个纤维指向的深度观测，并结合档案中的 MeerKAT Galaxy Cluster Legacy Survey 团核心数据及 Shapley Supercluster Survey 光学数据，构建了从维里化团中心到外围纤维的均匀星系样本。工作系统比较了星系的 HI 含量、恒星形成活动、气体耗尽时标和形态性质，并相对于气体分数与恒星形成主序进行分析。主要结果为：整体 HI 探测率从团中心的 30% 上升到纤维中的 45%；团中心 HI 探测星系以过渡区系统为主，而纤维中恒星形成主序星系与过渡区星系几乎各占一半，**表明从纤维到团中心存在持续的环境转变**。两类环境的气体性质不同：团中心星系向红序演化时 HI 储库逐渐耗尽，而纤维星系总体仍富气。纤维内超过哈勃时间的长 HI 耗尽时标集中于特定种群，**71% 的过渡区探测星系和 57% 的富气探测星系呈现这种长耗尽时标，指示原子气体转化为恒星的效率低下**。此外，纤维中 HI 探测星系以晚型星系为主，而其未探测到的背景种群主要是早型星系，**这支持星系在落入星系团之前已在外围纤维中经历环境预处理**。
summary: We investigate the neutral atomic hydrogen (HI) content of galaxies across the Shapley Supercluster (SSC) at z = 0.048 by combining new deep MeerKAT L band observations of five filament pointings with archival MeerKAT Galaxy Cluster Legacy Survey observations of the supercluster core. Together with optical data from the Shapley Supercluster Survey, these observations provide a homogeneous view of galaxy evolution from the virialised cluster environment to the surrounding filaments. We compare the HI content, star formation activity, gas depletion timescales, and morphological properties of galaxies relative to the gas fraction and star forming main sequences. The global HI detection fraction increases from 30 per cent in the cluster centre to 45 per cent in the filaments. While HI detected galaxies in the cluster centre are dominated by transition zone systems, the filament population is shared nearly equally between star forming main sequence and transition zone detections, indicating ongoing environmental transformation. Their gas properties also differ: cluster galaxies exhibit progressively depleted HI reservoirs towards the red sequence, whereas filament galaxies remain primarily gas rich. Within the filaments, long HI depletion timescales exceeding the Hubble time are concentrated in specific populations, notably 71 per cent of transition zone and 57 per cent of gas rich detections, indicating the inefficient conversion of atomic gas into stars. The HI detected filament population is dominated by late type galaxies, while the underlying non detected population is primarily composed of early type systems, consistent with environmental pre processing before cluster infall.

title: Sherlock 'Chrones: The Curious Case of NGC 6791 and Asteroseismic Targets Therein Reveals Mixing Length Dependence on Evolutionary Stage
background_knowledge: 星团由同一分子云在近似同一时期形成，成员星年龄和初始化学组成相近而质量不同，因而在颜色-星等图上呈现出主序、转折点、巨星分支等演化序列，是检验恒星演化理论的重要实验室。研究范式通常是把星团测光数据与一组等年龄线比较，以同时约束年龄、金属丰度、距离和消光；但模型中的对流处理会显著影响恒星半径、有效温度和演化轨迹。恒星内部对流是三维湍流过程，一维模型通常用混合长理论近似，并以自由参数 $\alpha_\text{MLT}$ 描述对流元的混合尺度。传统做法是用太阳标定得到 $\alpha_{\odot}$ 并假定其对所有恒星固定，但不同表面重力、金属丰度和演化阶段的恒星可能并不适用同一值。星震学通过振荡频率及相关全局量对恒星内部结构和全局参数提供高精度约束，使人们能在星团成员星上检验这一假设。NGC 6791 是年老、富金属的疏散星团，M92 是年老、贫金属的球状星团，二者年龄确定较好，适合作为对比样本。
contribution: 论文构建了采用不同 $\alpha_\text{MLT}$ 值的自定义等年龄线，并与两个年龄约束良好的星团——富金属疏散星团 NGC 6791 和贫金属球状星团 M92——的观测及星震学约束进行比较，以检验一维模型中固定太阳混合长的假设。对两个星团，最佳拟合的混合长参数均随演化阶段单调减小：NGC 6791 为 $0.98-1.10\alpha_{\odot}$，M92 为 $1.16-1.21\alpha_{\odot}$。在 NGC 6791 中，从主序转折点到红巨星分支上端，最佳拟合混合长约减小 18%。**该单一星团内部的 $\alpha_\text{MLT}$ 变化幅度已可与文献中其他非太阳目标拟合结果的离散程度相比，说明对星团采用单一 $\alpha_\text{MLT}$ 值可能不可靠；同时，这一趋势与更高保真度三维对流分析预言的 $\log g$–$\alpha_\text{MLT}$ 关系一致。** 因此，作者强调需要在等年龄线中更灵活地处理混合长，才能正确模拟星团。
summary: As single-aged populations containing stars spanning a range of masses but otherwise with similar properties, star clusters provide valuable testbeds for stellar evolution theory. The old, metal-rich, open cluster NGC 6791 is well studied, but the availability of asteroseismic observations of individual cluster members allows for a more in-depth analysis. Driven by mounting evidence that the solar assumption for convection used in almost all 1D stellar models is not adequate, and in light of the increased precision provided by modern data and asteroseismic constraints, we built and compared custom isochrones with varying values of the convective mixing length, $α_\text{MLT}$, to two clusters with well-determined ages: NGC 6791 and the well-studied, metal-poor globular cluster M92. For both clusters, we found that the best-fitting mixing length parameter decreases monotonically as a function of evolutionary phase, finding values between $0.98-1.10α_{\odot}$ for NGC 6791 and $1.16-1.21α_{\odot}$ for M92. In NGC 6791, this corresponds to an 18% decrease in the best fitting mixing length between the main sequence turn-off and upper end of the red giant branch. The degree of variation found within this one object is therefore comparable to variation across the literature in $α_\text{MLT}$ fits for other non-solar targets, calling single-valued $α_\text{MLT}$ fits to clusters into question. It is also consistent with $\log g$-$α_\text{MLT}$ trends predicted by higher-fidelity, 3D convection analyses. Our results therefore illustrate the need for more flexibility in our treatment of the mixing length in isochrones to properly model clusters.

title: Lunar laser ranging analyses of NGLR-1 data with PEP and prospects for MPAc: towards one millimeter range precision
background_knowledge: Lunar Laser Ranging（LLR，月球激光测距）通过地面台站向月面后向反射器发射激光脉冲并测量往返飞行时间，反演地月距离、月球轨道与自转、月球内部结构以及引力理论参数。它是太阳系尺度检验广义相对论（GR）和替代引力理论的重要实验手段，也可服务于月球地球物理学与大地测量学。传统 Apollo 与 Lunokhod 反射器由多个小角锥组成，月球天平动会使不同角锥的回波在时间上展宽，形成脉冲弥散，使历史数据的测距精度主要停留在厘米级。为突破这一限制，新一代方案采用大口径单角锥后向反射器（CCR），可消除多角锥之间的回波时延分散，使 LLR 有望进入毫米级精度。PEP（Planetary Ephemeris Program）是用于行星历表与 LLR 数据分析的软件，常通过法向点（normal points，NPs）压缩观测并评估残差与观测离散度。
contribution: 本文利用 Planetary Ephemeris Program（PEP）对 NGLR-1（首个部署在月面的 10 cm 直径单角锥后向反射器）的 LLR 观测进行了详细分析，考察了 APOL、Wettzell 和 Grasse 地面台站获得的单次测距、法向点（NPs）、残差与观测离散度。结果表明，**NGLR-1 相比 Apollo 与 Lunokhod 传统反射器阵列显著提升了飞行时间测量精度，验证了单大口径 CCR 消除脉冲弥散、推动 LLR 走向毫米级测距精度的能力**；研究还表明，**ESA 计划于 2027 年初发射的 MPAc 激光后向反射器（MoonLIGHT with Pointing Actuators）具有类似的良好应用前景**。该工作为开启 LLR 观测新阶段、增强对 GR 与替代引力理论的检验，并改进月球地球物理学与大地测量学奠定了基础。
summary: Since 1969, Lunar Laser Ranging (LLR) has provided critical data for investigating Earth-Moon dynamics, lunar internal structure, and tests of General Relativity (GR). However, the measurement precision of historical arrays (such as those from Apollo and Lunokhod missions) is inherently limited by laser pulse broadening induced by lunar librations. To overcome this limit, next-generation single Cube Corner Retroreflectors (CCRs) of large optical diameter have been developed to eliminate pulse dispersion, enabling LLR measurements to advance from centimeter-level precision down to the millimeter scale. In this work, we present a detailed analysis of LLR observations from NGLR-1 (Next Generation Lunar Retroreflector-1), the first single 10cm-diameter CCR deployed on the lunar surface. Carried out using the Planetary Ephemeris Program (PEP), this study investigates individual range measurements, normal points (NPs), residuals, and observational dispersion collected by the ground stations at Apache Point Observatory Lunar laser ranging station (APOL), Wettzell, and Grasse. The results: demonstrate the success of NGLR-1 in significantly enhancing time of flight measurement precision compared to legacy Apollo and Lunokhod retroreflector arrays; indicate similar good prospects also for ESA's MPAc laser retroreflector (MoonLIGHT with Pointing Actuators) to be launched in early 2027; pave the way for a new era of LLR observations and enhanced tests of GR, alternative gravity theories in general and improved lunar geophysics and geodesy.

title: Little Red Dots from Primordial Vacuum Bubbles
background_knowledge: 该方向位于暴胀宇宙学、原初黑洞物理与高红移天体观测的交汇处。暴胀通过量子涨落产生近标度不变的曲率扰动，其小尺度功率受到 CMB 谱畸变、原初黑洞丰度等限制；常规原初黑洞模型常需显著增强的小尺度曲率扰动，因而受到严格约束。另一类机制利用暴胀子之外的场、相变或真空泡成核，在无需大曲率扰动的情况下产生黑洞。JWST 发现的高红移 little red dots 是紧凑、偏红的天体，部分可能由 $10^6$ 至 $10^8\,M_\odot$ 量级的黑洞吸积供能；其数量密度与黑洞质量对早期黑洞形成机制提出挑战，也使原初黑洞成为候选解释之一。
contribution: 论文提出一种不依赖增强曲率扰动的原初黑洞形成机制：在暴胀过程中，暴胀子轨迹的横向量子隧穿使稀有真空泡在短暂暴胀区间成核，这些真空泡随后形成黑洞。该机制可产生质量约 $10^6$ 至 $10^8\,M_\odot$ 的原初黑洞，质量与丰度可调，质量谱很窄，宽度仅为百分量级，并可达到 JWST 观测到的 little red dots 的丰度，同时避开 CMB 谱畸变对增强曲率扰动的限制。**因此，原初真空泡可为高红移 little red dots 提供原初黑洞解释，且与现有观测约束相容。** 作者指出，最主要的限制来自黑洞吸积；即使吸积辐射全部以硬 X 射线逃逸，匹配明亮 little red dots 的黑洞族群仍满足该限制。
summary: Quantum tunneling transverse to the inflaton trajectory can produce $10^6$--$10^8M_\odot$ primordial black holes at the abundance of JWST's little red dots, without the enhanced curvature perturbations excluded by limits on CMB spectral distortions. Rare vacuum bubbles nucleate during a brief interval of inflation and later form black holes, with adjustable mass and abundance and a narrow mass spectrum of percent-level width. The leading constraint, from accretion, is satisfied for a population matching the bright little red dots even if all the emitted radiation escapes as hard X-rays.

title: Multimessenger constraints on the origin of long gamma-ray bursts with plateaus: three cases
background_knowledge: 长伽马射线暴（long gamma-ray bursts，LGRB）通常被解释为大质量恒星核心坍缩形成的坍缩星（collapsar）事件：坍缩后的致密中心引擎驱动极端相对论喷流，产生瞬时伽马射线辐射，并在与周围介质作用后形成 X 射线、光学和射电余辉。相当一部分 LGRB 的 X 射线余辉出现平台（plateau），说明中心引擎在瞬时辐射结束后仍持续注入能量。中心引擎的主流候选包括黑洞（BH）与毫秒磁星：前者可通过超吸积或 BH 自转能供能，后者通过磁星自转下降供能。吸积盘的非轴对称不稳定性、盘碎裂、BH 自转以及磁星自转均可产生引力波（GW），其频率、波形和持续时间直接编码中心引擎的质量、自转与吸积过程。多信使天文学将电磁辐射与 GW 联合，用地面探测器（LIGO/Virgo/KAGRA、Cosmic Explorer、Einstein Telescope）和空间探测器（DECIGO、Big Bang Observer）覆盖从 mHz 到 kHz 的频段，从而检验 LGRB 中心引擎的物理机制。
contribution: 论文比较带 X 射线平台的长暴在三种坍缩星中心引擎模型下的 GW 特征：模型 A 由 BH 超吸积驱动瞬时相，随后由 BH 自转下降驱动平台；模型 B 由 BH 自转下降同时驱动瞬时相；模型 C 由磁星同时供能瞬时相与平台。三者在 GW 的时间结构、能量和频率上各不相同，可表现为宽带辐射或相干下降 chirp。作者用模型 A 拟合 Swift 的 GRB 080319C、GRB 111209A 与 GRB 130925A 的 X 射线平台，得到 BH 质量约 $24$–$124$ 倍太阳质量，瞬时相结束时盘质量约为 $M_{BH}$ 的 10%。结合盘辐射数值模拟的质量标度，预言在 few hHz 频段产生约 $1.5\times10^{-24}$–$1.8\times10^{-24}$ 的 GW 应变；**Cosmic Explorer 与 Einstein Telescope 应可探测，推断发生率约 0.5–1.5 yr$^{-1}$**。由潮汐撕裂事件（tidal disruption event，TDE）供能的超长暴预期在 mHz–dHz 频段辐射 GW，可能进入 DECIGO 和/或 Big Bang Observer（BBO）的灵敏范围。**当前及未来探测器有望探测 BH 供能 LGRB 的 GW，而磁星引擎需要下一代探测器；多信使观测可用于描绘 LGRB 中心引擎的活动**。
summary: The central engines of long gamma-ray bursts (LGRBs) with X-ray plateaus remain uncertain. They involve a magnetar or black hole (BH), powered by spin energy and/or accretion. We examine how gravitational waves (GWs) discriminate between these scenarios. For collapsars, we consider three models: (A) a prompt phase powered by hyper-accretion onto a BH, followed by a spin-down-powered plateau; (B) a prompt phase powered by BH spin-down; and (C) a magnetar powering both the prompt and plateau phases. Each predicts a distinct GW signature in timing, energy, and frequency, ranging from broadband emission to a coherent descending chirp. We fit the selected X-ray plateaus of Swift GRBs using the model (A). For GRB~080319C, GRB~111209A, and GRB~130925A, we obtain BH masses of $M_{\rm BH}\sim24$--$124\,M_\odot$, with disc masses of $\sim10\%\,M_{\rm BH}$ at the end of the prompt phase. Mass-scaling of numerical simulations of disc emission yields GW strains of $\sim1.5-1.8\times10^{-24}$ at few hHz. This emission should be detectable by Cosmic Explorer and the Einstein Telescope, with an inferred rate from $0.5$ to $1.5$ yr$^{-1}$. However, ultra-long GRBs powered by tidal disruption events are expected to emit GWs at frequencies ranging from millihertz to decihertz, potentially within the sensitivity range of DECIGO and/or Big Bang Observer (BBO). Current or future detectors may detect GWs associated with BH-powered GRB, but magnetar engines, require next-generation detectors. Current and future detectors could map LGRB central-engine activity.

title: Peanut/X-shaped bulges: Returning to the vertical resonance and separatrix
background_knowledge:
盘星系中普遍存在恒星棒。棒是一种非轴对称的引力势结构；在随棒一起转动的参考系中，中心区域的大量恒星沿闭合轨道运动，共同支撑起棒的本体。在垂直方向上，棒的中心往往显著增厚：从侧面（edge-on）观测时，其亮度分布呈现盒状（boxy）或花生状（peanut），即所谓 BP 隆起；部分系统中还能看到从中心向外伸展的 X 形射线，称为 X 形隆起。银河系的中心棒—核球也被普遍认为属于这一类结构。因此，阐明 BP/X 结构的动力学起源，是星系内部结构形成与长期（secular）演化研究的核心问题之一。
\n关于其形成机制，目前主要有两类图像。其一是屈曲（buckling）不稳定性：细长的薄棒在垂直方向失稳并发生屈曲，使中心区域在垂直方向鼓胀。其二是垂直共振图像：当恒星的垂直振动与径向运动满足共振条件时，二者的相位被锁定，轨道在 $R$-$z$ 面上呈“香蕉”形或“8 字形”等特殊形状，这类共振轨道在相空间中聚集并堆积，形成 BP/X 的密度增强。当前的主流看法是，两种机制可能都起作用，而在长期演化中，共振捕获（resonant trapping）对于塑造并维持 BP/X 的“骨架”尤为关键。
\n描述共振轨道最方便的工具是作用量-角变量 $(J_R, J_z, \theta_R, \theta_z)$：其中 $J_R$ 与 $J_z$ 分别刻画径向与垂直运动的振幅，$\theta_R$ 与 $\theta_z$ 为相应的角变量。在棒的转动参考系中，当径向与垂直方向的频率成简单整数比时便发生共振；共振附近的动力学可近似为单摆：稳定平衡点对应天平动（libration），不稳定平衡点附近轨道运动极慢，二者由分界线（separatrix）分隔。分界线本身是一条不稳定共振轨道，其邻近区域容易形成“轨道拥挤”（orbital crowding），从而在恒星密度分布上留下可观测的印记。
\n研究方法上，一类是直接的 $N$-body 自洽模拟，用于追踪棒与核球的长期演化；另一类是“轨道骨架”（orbital skeleton）方法，即从模拟给出的引力势中构造纯共振轨道，用少量关键轨道重现 BP/X 的形态，从而揭示形态背后的动力学机制。将二者结合，可以回答“哪些轨道支撑了 X 形结构”“分界线如何随时间演化”等问题。
contribution: 本文基于一个 $N$-body 棒模型，在笛卡尔坐标以及作用量-角空间（$\theta_{\mathrm{res}} = \theta_z - \theta_R$，$J_z$）中，分析了构成 boxy/peanut/X-shaped（BP/X）隆起骨架的纯共振轨道，系统考察了棒的垂直结构与长期演化。研究发现，**这一骨架的主干由与不稳定的“8 字形”共振轨道相联系的分界线轨道构成**。作者**首次考察了分界线本身的长期行为**，发现它会**随时间向相空间底部下沉并逐渐收缩**。受此影响，原本属于扁平棒的“新鲜”轨道被**捕获进入垂直共振**，并在分界线附近穿越共振区，形成显著的**轨道拥挤**；**这一拥挤区域恰好对应 BP/X 隆起最厚的部分，并勾勒出 X 形结构射线的端点**。轨道的抬升（rise）又会反过来改变这些区域的引力势与相空间几何；当抬升过程停止后，系统的演化随之放缓并最终停止。
summary: We investigate the vertical structure and evolution of an $N$-body galactic bar by analyzing pure resonant orbits that form the skeleton of boxy/peanut/X-shaped (BP/X) bulges in Cartesian and action-angle spaces ($θ_\text{res} = θ_z - θ_R, \, J_z$). We show that the main backbone of this skeleton is made up of separatrix orbits associated with unstable figure-of-eight resonant orbits. For the first time, we examine the long-term behavior of the separatrix, showing how it sinks to the bottom of phase space and shrinks. As a result, ``fresh'' orbits involved in a flat bar are captured into vertical resonance, passing through it near the separatrix and creating orbital crowding. This crowding traces the thickest part of the BP/X bulge and outlines the ends of its X-structure rays. The rise of orbits leads to changes in the potential and geometry of phase space in these regions. Over time, when the rise ceases, evolution slows and stops.

title: Galaxy Bias and Soft Limits from Inflation
background_knowledge:
宇宙大尺度结构研究宇宙中的物质密度扰动如何从极早期演化至今，并通过星系巡天被观测。暴胀理论认为，早期宇宙的加速膨胀把量子涨落拉伸为原初曲率扰动；在最简单的单场慢滚模型中，这些扰动近似高斯分布，但多场暴胀、非标准动力学或其它早期宇宙机制可能产生原初非高斯性（primordial non-Gaussianity, PNG）。PNG 会在非常大的尺度上留下特征印记，尤其是通过尺度依赖的星系偏袒影响星系分布。
\n星系并非物质密度的完美示踪物，其形成和演化使其分布相对于暗物质存在偏袒。现代研究通常采用有效场论方法，把星系密度写成物质密度、潮汐场及其它偏袒算符的展开，并同时包含随机项。圈图修正会引入紫外发散，因此需要系统重整化，使理论预言与偏袒参数的定义保持一致。偏袒展开与微扰理论已成为利用星系巡天检验暴胀物理和引力理论的核心工具。
\n原初关联函数的软极限（长波模式趋于零动量）决定了 PNG 对偏袒的影响。传统分析多集中于双谱的挤压极限，但更高阶 PNG、多个长波模式以及多圈修正要求把这一图像推广为多软极限。论文正是在这一背景下，将偏袒算符的重整化与任意阶原初关联函数的多软极限联系起来。
contribution: 论文建立了在任意阶非零原初 $ n $ 点函数存在时、并包含随机贡献的偏袒算符多圈重整化框架。作者指出，**星系偏袒的重整化由原初关联函数与偏袒核的多软极限决定**，从而把通常基于双谱挤压极限的处理推广到更高阶 PNG。文中对偏袒展开至五阶的确定性算符给出了一圈与两圈重整化的显式计算，并进一步推导了偏袒参数在一圈和两圈的重整化群方程。
summary: Primordial non-Gaussianity (PNG) leaves an imprint on large-scale structure through a scale-dependent galaxy bias, and properly incorporating the effects of higher order PNG into the bias expansion requires a consistent renormalization framework that extends beyond the squeezed limit of the bispectrum. We develop the multi-loop renormalization of bias operators in the presence of non-vanishing primordial n-point functions of arbitrary order, including stochastic contributions. We show that galaxy bias renormalization is determined by the multi-soft limits of primordial correlators and bias kernels. We provide explicit computations for one- and two-loop renormalization of deterministic operators up to fifth order in the bias expansion. Finally, we derive the renormalization group equations for the bias parameters at one and two loops.

title: Two powers, one scalar field: unified early and late dark energy
background_knowledge: 现代宇宙学标准图像以 Friedmann-Lemaître-Robertson-Walker 度规和 Einstein 场方程为基础，认为宇宙当前处于加速膨胀阶段，通常用宇宙学常数 $\Lambda$ 或具有负压的暗能量成分描述。暗能量约占当前能量预算的 68%，其状态方程接近 $w\approx-1$；$\Lambda\mathrm{CDM}$ 模型用 $\Lambda$ 解释晚期加速，并成功拟合 CMB、BAO、超新星等多类观测。早期暗能量指在宇宙早期（复合前）不可忽略、随后迅速衰减的暗能量成分，可改变膨胀历史和声视界，从而影响 $H_0$ 推断。哈勃张力是 Planck CMB 推断的 $H_0$ 与 SH0ES 等近邻距离阶梯测量之间的差异。标量场暗能量（quintessence 等）通过势能 $V(\phi)$ 驱动动力学演化；统一早期与晚期暗能量的模型通常设计势能，使场在不同时期扮演不同角色。观测检验常联合 CMB、DESI BAO、Pantheon+ 超新星等数据，并用 $\chi^2$ 或信息准则比较模型。
contribution: 论文研究单个正则标量场能否同时解释早期与晚期暗能量，并采用双幂势：陡峭的正幂项可在早期产生标量能量密度占比的峰值，反幂项则支撑晚期加速；模型要求陡峭项最初主导、随后退居次主导。作者将模型与 CMB 测量、DESI 重子声学振荡（BAO）和 Pantheon+ 超新星数据以及 SH0ES 宿主距离校准联合检验。**该双幂势设计可在单一正则标量场框架内同时产生早期暗能量峰与晚期加速**。相对平坦 $\Lambda\mathrm{CDM}$，**数据拟合改善为 $\Delta\chi^2_{\rm data}=-6.90$；计入高斯参数先验惩罚后，目标函数改善为 $\Delta\chi^2_{\rm objective}=-3.76$**。该标量场模型给出 $H_0=69.53\pm0.26\,{\rm km\,s^{-1}\,Mpc^{-1}}$，而平坦 $\Lambda\mathrm{CDM}$ 为 $68.45\pm0.24\,{\rm km\,s^{-1}\,Mpc^{-1}}$；**这一移动使推断的膨胀率更接近 SH0ES 测量，但并未显著解决哈勃张力**。
summary: We investigate whether a single canonical scalar field can account for both early and late dark energy. We consider a double-power potential in which a steep positive-power term can generate an early peak in the scalar energy-density fraction, while an inverse-power term supports late-time acceleration. This evolution requires the steep term to dominate initially and become subdominant later. We test the model against cosmic microwave background (CMB) measurements, Dark Energy Spectroscopic Instrument (DESI) baryon acoustic oscillations, and Pantheon+ supernova data, with the SH0ES host-distance calibration. Relative to flat $Λ$CDM, the data fit improves by $Δχ^2_{\rm data}=-6.90$, or $Δχ^2_{\rm objective}=-3.76$ when Gaussian parameter-prior penalties are included. The scalar-field model gives $H_0=69.53\pm0.26\,{\rm km\,s^{-1}\,Mpc^{-1}}$, compared with $68.45\pm0.24\,{\rm km\,s^{-1}\,Mpc^{-1}}$ in flat $Λ$CDM. This shift brings the inferred expansion rate closer to the SH0ES measurement, but does not resolve the discrepancy significantly.

title: Modeling the gravitational wave spectrum from slowly-evolving sources in the early Universe: constant-in-time and coherent-decay models
background_knowledge: 该子领域研究早期宇宙中宏观能量释放或非平衡过程所产生的随机引力波背景（stochastic gravitational wave background，SGWB），并利用其能谱反推源的性质与热历史。常见源包括一阶相变中的气泡碰撞、等离子体中的声波与磁流体动力学（magnetohydrodynamic，MHD）湍流等；这些源通过应力-能量张量的横向无迹部分驱动引力波，源的持续时间、关联长度与退相干时间决定谱形。理论计算通常从源的不等时关联函数（unequal-time correlator，UETC）出发，对时间与波数积分得到今日引力波能谱；若源演化缓慢、退相干时间远长于引力波周期，可采用 Constant-in-Time（CiT）近似，将源视为统计定常，从而解析预言红外与紫外标度。早期宇宙相变与湍流源往往具有有限寿命和复杂时间相关，因此需要把源衰减与 UETC 的相干性纳入模型，才能连接数值模拟与可观测谱。
contribution: 论文在早期宇宙缓慢演化源产生引力波背景的框架下，系统研究并扩展了 Constant-in-Time（CiT）模型：在原有 CiT 描述基础上，引入源 UETC 的相干衰减（coherent-decay）描述，构建可处理不同源类型的通用框架，并以衰减 MHD 湍流、声波和一阶相变气泡碰撞为例讨论适用性。作者指出，**CiT 与相干衰减模型的有效性依赖于源具有较长的退相干时间**；当 UETC 的退相干时标变短时，**在 CiT 预言的谱之上会出现一个共振项**，这与早期关于湍流和声波产生引力波的解析结果一致。该框架与已有数值结果相容，并解释了**在辐射主导流体中声波产生引力波的效率高于亚相对论 MHD 湍流，而对相对论湍流这一优势不再成立**。CiT 模型给出通用谱形：**红外区按 $k^3$ 标度，中间频率呈线性 $k$，在高于源关联长度倒数的频段按 $k^{1-b_{\Pi}}$ 衰减**，其中 $b_{\Pi}$ 由源类型及其谱的紫外斜率唯一决定。由于 $k^3$ 与线性 $k$ 标度对缓慢演化源普遍出现，论文据此建议检验 CiT 框架对其他引力波源的可适用性。
summary: We study the production of gravitational wave (GW) backgrounds from slowly-evolving sources in the early Universe, following the Constant-in-Time (CiT) model, presented and validated against simulations of decaying turbulence in arXiv:2201.05630. We extend the CiT model to account for the source decay using a coherent description for the unequal-time correlator (UETC) of the source. We present a generic framework that allows us to study different types of sources. As examples, we discuss the applicability of this framework to the production of GWs from decaying MHD turbulence, sound waves, and bubble collisions in first-order phase transitions. We show that the validity of the CiT and the coherent-decay models presented in this work relies on long decorrelation times of the source. However, as the decorrelation timescale of the UETC becomes short, a resonant term grows on top of the GW spectrum predicted by the CiT model, as found, for example, in earlier analytical studies of GW production from turbulence and sound waves. This model is compatible with previous numerical results and explains why sound waves in a radiation-dominated fluid are more efficient than subrelativistic MHD turbulence in producing GWs, which is no longer the case for relativistic turbulence. The CiT model predicts a generic spectrum that scales as $k^3$ in the IR regime, develops a linear $k$ at intermediate frequencies, and decays as $k^{1-b_Π}$ at frequencies above the inverse correlation length scale of the source, where $b_Π$ is uniquely determined by the type of source and the UV slope of its spectrum. Since the $k^3$ and $k$ scalings always appear for slowly-evolving sources and they are commonly found in studies of GW production, we motivate checking the potential applicability of the CiT to other sources of GWs.

title: Direct inference of cosmological mass growth via timing of black hole - pulsar binaries
background_knowledge: 在现代宇宙学中，宇宙膨胀由标度因子 $a(t)$ 描述；在 ΛCDM 框架下，冷暗物质密度随膨胀稀释，暗能量驱动加速膨胀。标准广义相对论中的孤立黑洞通常由质量、自旋等参数描述，其质量在宇宙学时间尺度上不随膨胀增长，除非发生吸积或并合。所谓宇宙学耦合黑洞（cosmologically coupled black holes, CCBH）是一类广义相对论解，其引力质量随标度因子演化：$m_{\rm BH}\propto a^{\kappa}$。若 $\kappa\neq 0$，双星轨道会因质量变化产生额外的周期漂移，因此可用脉冲星计时检验。脉冲星是高度稳定的时钟；在黑洞—脉冲星双星中，脉冲到达时间可精确测量脉冲自转周期及其导数、轨道周期及其导数。观测到的周期导数还包含银河系加速度、星团势、Shklovskii 效应等运动学贡献。毫秒脉冲星（MSP）自转快、计时精度高，适合在数十年基线内寻找微小漂移；球状星团中可通过动力学相互作用形成黑洞—脉冲星系统。与利用类星体在十亿年尺度上的质量演化相比，脉冲星计时基线短、系统误差更可控。
contribution: 论文把球状星团中的黑洞—脉冲星候选体 J0514$-$4002E（脉冲自转周期 $P\sim 5.6~{\rm ms}$，轨道周期 $P_{\rm b}\sim 7~{\rm days}$）作为检验案例：在假定伴星为 CCBH 的前提下，利用其轨道周期导数与自转周期导数之差消去运动学效应，只剩脉冲星内禀自转减慢 $\dot{P}_{\rm int}$ 未知。取物理最小值 $\dot{P}_{\rm int}=0$，得到稳健上限 **$\kappa\leqslant 3.95$（95% 置信度）**。进一步用自转参数匹配的毫秒脉冲星族群估计 $\dot{P}_{\rm int}$，在 $H_0=67.6~{\rm km\,s^{-1}\,Mpc^{-1}}$ 与 $73.5~{\rm km\,s^{-1}\,Mpc^{-1}}$ 下分别得到 **$\kappa=0.82\pm 1.67$** 与 **$0.75\pm 1.54$**。按照计时精度随基线增长的典型标度，对于质量 $2.35^{+0.20}_{-0.18}\,M_{\odot}$ 的伴星，**到 2031 年和 2036 年可分别在 $3\sigma$ 与 $5\sigma$ 置信度上排除或探测 $\kappa=3$**；该值被其他工作用来把真空能黑洞内部与加速宇宙膨胀联系起来。论文由此展示了黑洞—脉冲星计时可作为直接、短基线且系统误差可控的宇宙学质量增长检验。
summary: Cosmologically coupled black holes (CCBHs) respond to the expansion of the Universe, independently of conventional astrophysical processes. Recent CCBH solutions in General Relativity demonstrate evolution of gravitating mass $m_{\rm BH}\propto a^κ$, where $a$ is the cosmological scale factor. This can be tested through the orbital period timing of black hole (BH) pulsar (PSR) binaries. In contrast to previous methods used to constrain $κ$, pulsar timing measurement baselines span decades instead of gigayears, allowing sources of bias to be well-controlled. As a test case, we analyze the globular cluster BH+PSR candidate J0514--4002E (spin $P\sim 5.6~{\rm ms}$, orbital period $P_{\rm b}\sim 7~\rm days$) under the assumption that the companion is a CCBH. Taking the difference between the observed orbital and spin period derivatives removes all kinematic effects, leaving only the pulsar's intrinsic spin-down $\dot{P}_{\rm int}$ as unknown. Setting $\dot{P}_{\rm int} = 0$, its physical minimum, gives a robust upper bound $κ\leqslant 3.95$ at $95\%$ confidence. We estimate $\dot{P}_{\rm int}$ through the population of millisecond pulsars matched in spin and infer $κ= 0.82 \pm 1.67$ and $0.75 \pm 1.54$, using $H_0 = 67.6$ and $73.5\,{\rm km\,s^{-1}\,Mpc^{-1}}$, respectively. Adopting typical baseline scaling of timing precision, the value $κ= 3$, argued elsewhere to link energized vacuum BH interiors to accelerated cosmological expansion, can be excluded or detected for this $2.35^{+0.20}_{-0.18}\,M_\odot$ companion at $3σ$ and $5σ$ confidence by 2031 and 2036, respectively.

title: Worldsheet Effective Theory of Abelian-Higgs Cosmic Strings beyond Nambu--Goto
background_knowledge: 宇宙弦是一维拓扑缺陷，可在早期宇宙对称性破缺相变中通过 Kibble 机制形成。其宏观运动通常由 Nambu–Goto 作用量描述：世界面面积决定动力学，横向 Goldstone 模编码弦的形变，而弦的有限厚度与内部结构被忽略。真实场论中，弦芯可存在寿命较长的标量、矢量等内部激发；当这些模与横向运动发生非线性耦合时，会改变弦的演化、稳定性以及引力波和辐射信号。Abelian-Higgs 模型是研究局域宇宙弦的基准微观模型，临界耦合下标量自由度与规范场自由度质量相近，弦芯结构及内部模最为丰富。该方向的研究范式是：从微观场论出发，利用有效世界面理论系统积分掉弦芯自由度，保留相关低能模，并以晶格场论模拟检验；核心问题包括内部模谱、非线性相互作用、曲率耦合、不稳定性及可观测后果。
contribution: 本文在临界耦合的 Abelian-Higgs 模型中，直接从微观场论推导宇宙弦耦合动力学的协变世界面有效理论，所有相互作用系数均由微观理论固定，并用数值晶格场论模拟进行验证。所得作用量在 Nambu–Goto 描述之外，引入一个**有质量的标量形状模**和一个**有质量的矢量模**。对矢量模做对偶化后，作者发现两种内部模具有不同的几何耦合：**标量形状模耦合到世界面本征曲率，而对偶得到的赝标量耦合到法丛曲率**。这些耦合**解释了晶格模拟中观察到的两类不同参数不稳定性**，并**预言碰撞横向波的相对偏振可控制两种内部模的激发**。该工作将宇宙弦的微观结构与非线性世界面动力学联系起来，为超越 Nambu–Goto 近似的宇宙弦研究提供了可预测框架。
summary: Cosmic strings can support long-lived excitations confined to their cores, opening channels for energy exchange with the transverse Goldstone modes that describe the string's motion. We derive a covariant worldsheet theory of their coupled dynamics directly from the Abelian-Higgs model at critical coupling, with all interaction coefficients fixed by the microscopic theory. The resulting action, which we validate against numerical lattice field theory simulations, extends the Nambu--Goto description to include a massive scalar shape mode and a massive vector mode. Dualizing the vector reveals a geometric distinction: the shape scalar mode couples to intrinsic worldsheet curvature, while the pseudoscalar couples to normal bundle curvature. These interactions explain the distinct parametric instabilities observed in lattice simulations and predict how the relative polarization of colliding transverse waves controls the excitation of the two internal modes. Our results connect microscopic string structure to the nonlinear worldsheet dynamics, providing a predictive framework for cosmic strings beyond the Nambu--Goto approximation.

title: The origin of the apparent ULX deficit in NGC 3256
background_knowledge: 超亮 X 射线源（ultra-luminous X-ray source, ULX）通常指位于星系核外、X 射线光度 $L_{\rm X}\gtrsim 10^{39}\ \mathrm{erg\ s^{-1}}$ 的明亮点源，主流解释是高质量 X 射线双星（high-mass X-ray binary, HMXB）中的致密天体以超 Eddington 吸积率吸积伴星物质。由于 HMXB 的大质量供体星寿命短，ULX 数量与近期恒星形成活动密切相关，并常用 ULX 数量与恒星形成率（star formation rate, SFR）之间的局域标度关系来预测星系中的 ULX 数目。ULX 的探测和统计还受宿主星系尘埃遮蔽、金属丰度、双星演化、黑洞质量分布及 X 射线能段选择效应影响；高分辨率 X 射线成像（如 Chandra）是区分核外点源、研究其光度函数与暂现性质的关键手段。
contribution: 论文分析合并型亮红外星系（luminous infrared galaxy, LIRG）NGC 3256 的三次 Chandra 观测，其 SFR 约为 $50$–$60\ M_\odot\ \mathrm{yr}^{-1}$，按局域标度关系预期可有 $100$–$120$ 个 ULX，从而可能显著影响星系能量学和反馈。作者刻画各次观测中每个 X 射线点源的光度，并联合所有观测判断其 ULX 性质、估计暂现 ULX 比例并构建 ULX 光度函数。结果显示，**NGC 3256 拥有 10–15 个 ULX，是迄今已知 ULX 最丰富的星系之一**；虽然按 ULX 与 SFR 之比可预期约 100 个 ULX，但**在考虑其极高金属丰度后，NGC 3256 并未表现出 ULX 短缺，甚至可能存在超出**。作者进一步指出，**LIRG 中的高遮蔽并非解释该星系 ULX 与 SFR 之比所必需**；若遮蔽仍有作用，则 LIRG 产生 ULX 的效率可能显著高于同金属丰度的正常星系，这与先前结果不一致。
summary: Ultra-luminous X-ray (ULX) sources are bright, off-nuclear X-ray point sources, mostly associated with high-mass X-ray binaries (HMXBs), with a compact object accreting from a donor star at super-Eddington luminosities. Although their HMXB nature implies a connection to star formation processes, previous works have found that luminous infrared galaxies (LIRGs) appear to have a deficit of ULXs compared to their very high star formation rates (SFRs). Here, we analyze three Chandra observations of NGC 3256, a merging LIRG with SFR ~50-60 Msun/yr. Based on local scaling relations, it could be expected to host between 100-120 individual ULXs, which could have a non-negligible impact on the energetics and feedback processes of the galaxy. We aim to characterize all its detected X-ray point sources to determine if there is a ULX deficit in this galaxy. We also aim to explore the potential impact of host-galaxy obscuration and metallicity in said deficit. We characterize the luminosity of each X-ray point source in each Chandra observation, and use all observations to determine their potential ULX nature and the fraction of transient ULXs, as well as construct a ULX luminosity function for this galaxy. We find that the galaxy hosts 10-15 ULXs, making it one of the most ULX-rich galaxies known to date. While comparison with the ULX/SFR ratio of nearby galaxies predicted as many as ~100 ULXs, we show that, when accounting for its very high metallicity, NGC 3256 does not have a ULX deficit; and may even present an excess. While the high obscuration in LIRGs has previously been invoked to explain the ULX deficit, we conclude that it is not required to explain the ULX to SFR ratio in NGC 3256. If obscuration still plays a role, then LIRGs may actually be significantly more efficient at producing ULXs than normal galaxies (of the same metallicity), in disagreement with previous results.

title: Square Kilometre Array Science Data Challenge 3b: EoR inference
background_knowledge: 宇宙复合之后进入“黑暗时代”，首批恒星和星系形成并逐步把周围的中性氢电离，这一过程称为宇宙再电离（Epoch of Reionization，EoR）。中性氢的 21 cm 超精细跃迁在红移后落入低频射电波段，因而可通过射电干涉阵列进行三维层析，追踪电离区增长和中性氢比例随红移的演化。该领域的研究范式通常包括：用半解析或数值模拟生成再电离信号，叠加前景辐射、仪器噪声和系统效应，形成功率谱或成像数据；再用贝叶斯推断等方法反演中性氢比例、电离源参数及再电离历史。关键困难在于 21 cm 信号远弱于银河系和河外星系前景，且仪器响应、信号建模和推断方法均可能引入系统偏差，因此需要通过盲挑战比较不同流程的稳健性。
contribution: 论文介绍并分析了 SKAO 组织的 Science Data Challenge 3b（SDC3b）结果；该挑战于 2024 年 10 月至 2025 年 5 月持续 9 个月，是首次在共同模拟数据集上对宇宙再电离推断流程开展社区范围的比较。挑战使用多组模拟 SKA 数据，涵盖无前景和有前景污染的柱状功率谱与成像产品，并采用不同再电离场景和模拟模型；共有 16 支团队参与，采用多种方法推断 $z=8.41$ 到 $z=6.25$ 三个红移区间内中性氢比例的后验分布。结果显示，**即使仅在宇宙学信号上加入仪器噪声这一较简单情形，不同团队得到的天体物理约束仍存在显著差异**，说明需要进一步厘清信号建模、仪器效应处理和推断方法各自对结论稳健性的贡献。尽管个别方法可能给出有偏的参数估计，**多团队估计的联合平均仍接近输入真值，表明独立方法有望抵消各自的方法偏差**。
summary: We present and analyse the results of Science Data Challenge 3b (SDC3b; https://sdc3.skao.int/challenges/inference), an Epoch of Reionization (EoR) inference exercise organised by the Square Kilometre Array Observatory (SKAO) using simulated SKA data. The nine-month challenge, running from October 2024 to May 2025, represents the first community-wide comparison of EoR inference pipelines on common simulated datasets. We consider multiple datasets designed to assess performance on both foreground-free and foreground-contaminated cylindrical power spectra and imaging products, adopting different reionization scenarios and EoR simulation models. We include results from 16 teams, which employ a range of methodologies to infer the posterior distribution of the hydrogen neutral fraction across three redshift intervals spanning z=8.41 to z=6.25. The results show significant inter-team variability of the astrophysical constraints even in the simpler case where only instrumental noise is added to the cosmological signal. This underscores the need for further investigation into the relative contributions of signal modelling, the treatment of instrumental effects, and inference methods to the robustness of the resulting conclusions. Although individual methods can produce biased parameter estimates, the combined average of their estimates remains close to the input values, suggesting that independent approaches can offset method-specific biases.

title: Multiphase Gas in High-$z$ Cosmic Sheets
background_knowledge: 现代宇宙学把大尺度结构描述为由暗物质主导的宇宙网：物质在引力不稳定性下坍缩，形成 void、片层（sheets/walls）、filament 与 node 组成的层级结构。高红移宇宙片层是宇宙网中较扁平的稠密界面，连接或包围 filament，并处于星系际介质（IGM）的整体光致电离背景中。冷而致密的气体可在局部冷却、压缩并自屏蔽，形成温度约 $10^4\ \mathrm{K}$、中性氢比例较高的多相结构；当其中性氢柱密度 $N_{\rm HI}$ 足够高时，会在背景类星体光谱中表现为 Lyman-limit 系统（LLS），柱密度略低者称为部分 LLS（pLLS）。观测上常以 LLS/pLLS 的数密度、覆盖度与金属丰度统计来约束冷气体在宇宙网中的比例和起源；数值上则需同时解析冷却、光致电离与自屏蔽、流体不稳定性、剪切和湍流等多尺度过程，因此高分辨率宇宙学流体模拟是连接宇宙网气体物理与吸收线观测的重要研究范式。
contribution: 作者使用 moving-mesh 代码 AREPO 对 $z=3-6$ 的单个宇宙片层开展高分辨率宇宙学模拟，专门研究弥漫宇宙网中温度约 $10^4\ \mathrm{K}$ 的冷气体。结果显示，宇宙片层冷气体呈**碎裂化形态**，表现为中性氢柱密度 $N_{\rm HI}$ 在 kpc 尺度上的显著变化。这种碎裂源于冷而致密的片层核心发生弯曲并瓦解为多相介质；**非线性薄壳不稳定性（NTSI）以及随后由剪切诱导的涡量驱动了弯曲，而非此前提出的热不稳定性或 Richtmyer-Meshkov 不稳定性**。提高分辨率会增强碎裂：在空间分辨率跨越 4 倍的范围内，pLLS 与 LLS 的 $N_{\rm HI}$ 覆盖度提高约 1.5 至 3.5 倍。量级估计表明，宇宙片层可能承载**超低金属丰度 (p)LLS 群体的很大一部分**。同等设置的 MP-Gadget 模拟也显示定性相似的碎裂，但存在数值平滑效应；尽管分辨率已很高，**宇宙片层气体性质仍未收敛**。
summary: We present high-resolution cosmological simulations of individual cosmic sheets ($z=3-6$) using the moving-mesh code AREPO to study cold gas ($T\approx10^4\rm ~K$) in the diffuse cosmic web. We find cosmic sheet gas forms a fragmented morphology, evident as kiloparsec-scale variations in the neutral hydrogen column density ($N_{\rm HI}$). Fragmentation arises from the bending and disruption of the cold-dense sheet core into a multiphase medium. Nonlinear thin shell instability (NTSI) and later shear-induced vorticity drive this bending, rather than previously suggested thermal or Richtmyer-Meshkov instabilities. Higher resolution enhances fragmentation. Across a fourfold range in spatial resolution, $N_{\rm HI}$ covering fractions increase by factors of $\approx 1.5-3.5$ for partial Lyman-limit systems (pLLS) and Lyman-limit systems (LLS). An order-of-magnitude estimate suggests sheets may host a large fraction of the ultra-low metallicity (p)LLS population. Equivalent MP-Gadget simulations show qualitatively similar fragmentation, but numerical smoothing effects are present. Cosmic-sheet gas properties remain unconverged despite our high resolutions.

title: Kinetic Tomography with Diffuse Interstellar Bands in APOGEE DR17
background_knowledge: 银河系的星际介质（ISM）由气体和尘埃组成，是恒星形成与银河系结构演化的物质基础。星际介质包含分子云、原子气体、离子气体和尘埃等多种形态，恒星形成主要发生在冷而致密的分子云中。要理解云团、空洞、旋臂以及银河系盘的整体结构如何形成和运动，需要同时知道星际介质的 3D 空间分布与沿视线方向的速度，也就是构建 4D 图景。弥散星际带（DIBs）是弥散星际介质中复杂分子造成的宽吸收特征，其强度与尘埃柱密度相关，其多普勒位移反映尘埃加权的视线速度，因此可作为联系尘埃密度与速度的示踪物。动力学层析（kinetic tomography，KT）利用大量恒星视线上的吸收特征，联合推断云团的距离与视向速度，进而重建银河系星际介质的密度与速度场。该方向的关键难点包括视线积分造成的距离-速度歧义、恒星距离误差、低信噪比探测，以及从稀疏且不均匀的采样中重建连续场；常用统计工具包括高斯过程、变分推断与层次贝叶斯模型，并需要利用独立尘埃图、脉泽和年轻星团等示踪物进行校验。
contribution: 论文基于 APOGEE DR17 中波长为 15,273 Å 的高质量 DIB 探测，构建太阳周围 6 kpc 内的 4D（3D 位置 + 视向速度）银河系动力学层析图。方法上，作者将变分推断与高斯过程结合，采用混合似然处理低信噪比探测，并对距离不确定性进行边缘化；模型先在模拟天区和光谱注入测试上标定，再用 3D 尘埃图、脉泽和年轻星团等独立示踪物校验密度与速度子结构。结果显示，他们恢复了 15,273 Å DIB 密度与速度结构的三维后验分布，测量了 DIB 盘的大尺度结构（标长、标高与 flare（外张）），并探测到与银河系翘曲（warp）一致的垂向畸变；在小尺度上，该图能够分辨气体经度-速度图中的距离歧义。由二阶速度结构函数得到斜率 $0.64 \pm 0.04$ 与 Kolmogorov 湍流一致，振幅与分子云预期相符，并给出了压缩模与螺线模（solenoidal modes）之比的初步结果。**这些结果表明，基于 DIB 的动力学层析可在统计上重建银河系星际介质的密度与速度结构，并为研究云团与空洞的形成和动力学提供新途径；随着 SDSS-V 提供更大的 DIB 星表，该框架有望分辨更小尺度的运动学子结构。**
summary: Context: Mapping gas flows in the interstellar medium is key to understanding the formation of structure in our Milky Way. Methods that simultaneously reconstruct clouds' distances and line-of-sight velocities are called kinetic tomography (KT). Diffuse interstellar bands (DIBs) are powerful tracers for such maps because they trace the integrated dust density and the dust-weighted velocity. Previous DIB-KT works had small samples with coarse kpc-scale resolution and could not capture vertical disk structure. Aims: Make 4D (3D position + radial velocity) maps of the Milky Way from new, high-quality 15,273 Å DIB detections in APOGEE DR17.
